# RIGGED!
---
|
---
| | |
---
| Friends, By now, it’s more than clear that the Republican National Committee (RNC) is trying to rig the primary. But I’m not backing down, and with your help, we can send a message to the DC establishment that we’re not going to play their rigged game. Remember: we did everything necessary to qualify for the debate. We followed the published rules, and thanks to patriots like you, we met all the criteria:
* We **EXCEEDED** the RNC’s requirement of at least 40,000 individual donors;
* We **EXCEEDED** the RNC’s requirement of 200 donors in 20 states (our team nearly doubled that, with 200+ donors in at least 37 states);
* We **MET** the RNC’s polling requirement of at least 1% in select polls, and we provided the detailed cross tabs of such polls.

But they shut us out anyway. [**Perhaps they thought we would go away quietly. Well, they thought wrong.**](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=37a96577ba&e=0be619cbaa)

[**I won’t let them silence us. But now more than ever, my campaign is counting on YOU to help us fight back.**](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=e25feff861&e=0be619cbaa) That’s why I announced that I’m filing an FEC complaint against the RNC. I’m not going to let the Washington establishment silence the voice of We the People and rig the process for the Republican establishment. Since I announced my intention to fight this fraudulent decision, I’ve received overwhelming support, from [patriots like Kari Lake](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=5ffaf809d2&e=0be619cbaa) and[ Deroy Murdock](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=98e7857c9b&e=0be619cbaa), as well as thousands of hardworking Americans who have told the RNC that I belong on that debate stage. At the very least, the RNC must guarantee that I will appear in the next one. It’s the only honorable and just thing to do. They want me to fall in line, but I won’t. I want them to understand what you do: I’m an independent conservative voice who owes nothing to the Washington establishment. I’m not a billionaire, and I’m not a career politician beholden to special interests. When I’m president, I will take this country back for hard-working, law-abiding citizens, and together, we will bring about a New American Golden Age. [**PLEASE DONATE WHAT YOU CAN AND HELP US SEND A MESSAGE TO THE RNC: WE WILL NOT BE SILENCED.**](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=5fb9b69cf8&e=0be619cbaa) Thank you,
Larry Elder
GOP Candidate for President

Good morning, friends, we are very excited to have you as a part of #TeamBerbrick. As we zone in on the final seven days of the election, wanted to make sure you saw the latest news to know about our momentum and all the great work our volunteers are doing on the ground.

Please feel free to email, call or text with any questions.

Kate Cantwell

>
>
> \---------- Forwarded message ---------
> From: **Kate Cantwell** <[kate@walterberbrick.com](mailto:kate@walterberbrick.com)>
> Date: Wed, Aug 23, 2023 at 11:39 AM
> Subject: (HTML VERSION): It's a leadership question

>
>
>
>
> __
> Berbrick calls out opponents for lack of judgement.| | | [](https://walterberbrick.com/?emci=98a3b7c5-f440-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=)
> ---
> | | [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/berbrick-for-congress-1)
> ---
> | |
> # #TeamBerbrick Leads On Leadership
> ---
> Writing from our office headquarters, we are officially 13 days from this historic primary. _That is it, 13 days._ Yesterday, Walter Berbrick was a featured guest on the Dan Yorke Show before taking the debate stage to call out our opponent on a ridiculous press conference they led. With no data, creating the illusion this is a two person race, our opponent brought in a former candidate who dropped out and alluded other candidates in this field should consider dropping out and endorsing the insider 'leading' candidate. Walter Berbrick quickly responded pointing out the lack of leadership and judgement, "this is an insider, supporting an insider, in an election designed to support insiders." Reflecting on the press conference, Berbrick was the only candidate to point out:
> * This is still a **wide open race** and there is no independent polling to suggest otherwise.
> * **It is a question of leadership and judgement** and if there were any facts, they should have reached out directly for a conversation and made their case, not grandstanding at a press conference.
>
Other great news coming out of HQ, #TeamBerbrick purchased our first social media ads which will be present with targeted voters until election day! This follows up thousands of mailers going out to voters on top of great local media coverage. **As part of #TeamBerbrick, what can you give to get Walter Berbrick to Congress? Literally 6 hours before the end of August can help us get over the finish line and victory on September 5th.** This weekend we will be in Jamestown, East Providence and if you would rather be in your own neighborhood we can set that up too! It is easy to drop flyers with a list and sharing why you support Walter Berbrick and making phone calls from anywhere in the U.S. from the comfort of home. What will you do to get Walter Berbrick to Congress? Email Kate [ kate@walterberbrick.com ](mailto:kate@walterberbrick.com "kate@walterberbrick.com")or call/text [401-447-0346](tel:4014470346 "tel:4014470346").
> _Take a look at the highlights from the road and how Berbrick is outshining the competition:_
> ---
> |
> ---
> | | [](https://walterberbrick.com/?emci=98a3b7c5-f440-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=)
> ---
> |
> # Berbrick Most Qualified & Impressive
> ---
> This week, Walter Berbrick was featured across multiple media platforms and when commentators and reporters see how much #leadership and #experience Walter Berbrick will bring to Washington, we get quotations such as this from [Robert Whitcomb, ](https://www.golocalprov.com/news/whitcomb-warm-up-the-warming-issue-in-search-of-supplies-home-hell-and-comf?emci=98a3b7c5-f440-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=) "... He’s an expert on global warming, including its national-security and economic challenges. The Ocean State, of course, must deal with the challenges of rising seas associated with climate change.Beyond that increasingly important expertise, Dr. Berbrick has shown himself to be a very civic-minded citizen in a range of nonprofit activities, and has a salt-of-the-earth background that helps him connect with a very wide range of people."
> ---
> | |
> # **Berbrick starts ad campaign**
> ---
> Our campaign is hyper-focused to meet voters, increase our name recognition, and meet people where they are and live. Since last we spoke, three mailers have launched and this week we begin our social media ad buy on Facebook and Instagram. Friends, this is the time **we need you to start sharing why you support Walter and sharing our donation link with your networks.** Will you match or help raise funds today? Let’s win this!
> ---
> [Donate Today!](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/berbrick-for-congress-1)
> ---
> |
> ---
> | |
> ---
> |
> # Vote Early & Poll Location
> ---
> Friends, it goes without saying, the only poll that really matters is the one on September 5th. Whether you vote early at your local town hall or on the day of the election, it is critical you have what you need to vote for Walter Berbrick, first on the ballot. 1) If you are voting on election day, make sure you bring a photo ID and** double check your polling location. **With a special election, some towns have merged polling locations. You can double check your location here. [Polling Location Click Here](https://vote.sos.ri.gov/Home/PollingPlaces?ActiveFlag=2&emci=98a3b7c5-f440-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=) Do you need a ride to the polls or town hall? Text or call 401-447-0346 with your needs.
> ---
> | |
> # Reaching the Voters
> ---
> We are wrapping a week interviews across the state with great links to share with friends and family about why they need to support Walter Berbrick and his focus to fight against rising cost, rising seas, and rising division. Here is a quick run down on where you can hear news about Walter Berbrick. [ABC 6 with John DeLuca ](https://www.abc6.com/meet-the-candidates-walter-berbrick/?emci=98a3b7c5-f440-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=) [WPRI 12 Newsmakers with Ted Nesi & Tim White at the 14 min 30 second mark. ](https://podcasts.google.com/feed/aHR0cHM6Ly9mZWVkcy5zaW1wbGVjYXN0LmNvbS9rUWVub3QybA/episode/NjE5ZjQyMzktZTVmMy00M2UxLTg0ZjgtMTgzMDYzNzhiOTc1?sa=X&ved=0CAUQkfYCahcKEwjQ_MKj4fCAAxUAAAAAHQAAAAAQAQ&hl=en&emci=98a3b7c5-f440-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=) How did Walter answer the question, "What do you think voters should know about your background that makes you stand out from the other candidates?"[ Click here to find out.](https://www.wpri.com/meet-the-candidates-walter-berbrick/?emci=98a3b7c5-f440-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=)
> ---
> |
> ---
> | |
> # Upcoming Debates & Profiles
> ---
> | | Walter Berbrick looks forward to sharing his experience and platform with voters across multiple debates and forums as we get closer to the election. We will share any new public seating opportunities or streaming websites as we get closer. Updated watch list: On August 29th, WPRI-12 will broadcast a live debate at 7 p.m. from the Rhode Island College campus. All Democratic primary candidates who qualify under the Nexstar Media Inc. nationwide criteria will be invited to participate. The debate will be moderated by WPRI’s Tim White and Ted Nesi. Tickets reserved for the campaign are on a first come, first served basis and can be reserved at this website. [Click Here](https://www.eventbrite.com/e/reserved-seating-walter-berbrick-campaign-wpri-12-ri-cd1-primary-debate-tickets-701450315777?aff=oddtdtcreator&emci=98a3b7c5-f440-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=) On August 31st, NBC 10 will be filming the debate and we will update you with more details on when the debate will air. If you cannot make those nights Walter and #TeamBerbrick will be at Mix and Mingles hosted by Newport This Week, Greater Newport Chamber, and the League of Women voters on the 28th and Valley Breeze/WNRI in Woonsocket on the 30th.
> ---
> | |
> ---
> |
> # Volunteer Spotlight
> ---
> This week, we want to spotlight and give a **HUGE THANK YOU to Spencer Johnson.** Spencer is a student at Providence College who has been instrumental for us to reach grassroots supporters to fund the media ads and mailers . Spencer continues the tradition of service to others, just like Walter and his father, a West Point graduate. Spencer, #TeamBerbrick would not be the same without you.
> ---

> ---
> |
> ---
> |
> ---

Kenneth Walsh](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z0lv9nt7aih9of59pjn64mjacblm58vaee0sv2r0_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t46mqj4t5m6gpr2d9j6kprct9jmkrncst66uqrf8j0c9j6f830suh61pt5mkoj8cdlkupjb85nmerr4td5mupr2d1kumir8cjkmeqjb9hnm9o7ctd1m5qqcdthmmjbactjmkon1dd7egorcs5nk8gq48bi4bh28or4sph64pr3c9ie49fg)
Marine Corps Lt. Col. Kenneth Ambrose Walsh was considered by many to be one of the toughest, most aggressive combat pilots of World War II. That reputation as a hard-fighting ace solidified in 1943 in the South Pacific when he took out several Japanese aircraft to help secure the Solomon Islands for the Allies. His bravery earned him the Medal of Honor.

No one else particularly cares for shrimp.
And lots and lots of fun little trips.
Playing board games and eating popcorn every night.
Seal Beach Pier Playground- It is just steps away from the beach, it is enclosed by a wall covered in beautifully hand painted tiles, and it is a great little playground appropriate for both my six year old and my two year old. You can definitely make a day of it. Pack a lunch or snack, hang out on the beach, let the kiddos play at the playground, and take a walk down Main Street. There are some fabulous little shops and some delish food. Make sure to stop off for two slices of thin crust pizza {huge slices} and a soda for $6 at Slice of New York Pizza. They don't have a web page, so I will provide you with a bit of info. Their address is 142 Main Street Seal Beach, California 90740. My hubby is Italian, so I have been thoroughly groomed in my pizza critiquing and this pizza definitely makes the cut. Don't forget a little bit of sweet at Sweet Jill's. Try their cinnamon roll. It is sharable, gooey, and delicious. One of my favorite stops on Main Street is Raspberry & Sage. It is filled with gorgeous goodies for the littles from clothing to hair accessories to gifts for mom.
I'm off to go play Sorry, bake cookies, and snuggle with my summer lovies.
I made myself my own little shrimp version.
I may try my hand at making some strawberry freezer jam this week.
Powell's Sweet Shoppe- This is the cutest, most amazingly stocked sweet shop I have ever been too. They have gourmet chocolates, gelato, cupcakes, and a huge array of our old school candy favorites. We love to spend the evening on 2nd Street in Belmont Shores, and a stop at Powell's is the sweet ending to a fun-filled evening. While you are in Belmont Shores, stop off at Frosted Cupcakery.Their Royal White and Vanilla Buttercream is simply out of this world. Also, ask for their Strawberry Lemonade cupcake. I can't even think about it without my mouth beginning to water. Their cupcakes are $2.95, and I would recommend ordering a couple cupcakes and sharing. Their cupcakes are quite decadent.
There are so many awesome activities ad amazing places to go that are virtually free.
{Hopefully, this June gloom will go away and we'll have a little more sun to have fun in.}
[kidsbowlfree.com](http://kidsbowlfree.com) \- My awesome friend Cathy passed along this amazing information, and I have already signed my kiddos up. You get 2 free games of bowling every single day of the summer for each of your children. All you have to worry about is shoe rentals, but those aren't very expensive. It can be as little as $3 for each child. It is available in every state for those of you who were getting tired of my ramblings of summer fun in only California that did not include you.
Shrimp was on sale, and I am a huge seafood fan.
Happy Wednesday!!!
Although, my son did try it.
We still have a ton left over.

Friend -- Earlier this month, I was proud to join _Black Virginia News_ to discuss my work on voting rights as well as my work with Meet Our Moment, the initiative I started to recruit and train minority and female Democratic candidates to run for and win state and local offices across the Commonwealth. To date, Meet Our Moment has trained over 50 Virginians, many of whom are running for office this November, and we're just getting started. name: Nikki Haley
subject: An incredible night
body:
an incredible night

| |
---
| | | | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c675836%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=gc1FZZxDjtrZywh4VOXP1Q&sysid=1)
---

Friend,

Wednesday night I finished my first Presidential Debate, and it was incredible!

Whether it was tackling out-of-control spending, securing our border, taking on China and Russia, standing up for our girls, or laying out my plan to make America strong and proud, I made sure to have an honest discussion with the American people.

We need a new generation of leadership in the White House, and I am ready to get to work.

We have a country to save, but I need your help to make that happen.

**[Can I count on your support so we can reach every American with my message, win the White House, and SAVE our future?](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c675837%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=BsN2Q9uICS4IU1jctiNg9A&sysid=1 "Can I count on your
support so we can reach every American with my message, win the White House, and
SAVE our future?")**
| | | [DONATE NOW](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c675838%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=rBEeGtEyATxdmwjE2PKxJQ&sysid=1)
---

Friend, in the greatest nation in history, 78% of our country is worried their kids won’t be better off. That is NOT okay.

My parents came here more than 50 years ago to an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. _I want them to see America again. _

When we focus on faith, family, and the fact that America is the best country in the world, that's when our best days are ahead of us.

**[I’m putting in the work. Will you join me in the fight for our country’s future?](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c675839%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=TmJu7twDJp%2fW7fg7wdN1Qw&sysid=1 "I’m putting in the work.
Will you join me in the fight for our country’s future? ")**

**[If you agree with my vision for our country’s future- an America that is STRONG and PROUD, NOT WEAK and WOKE - please rush in a donation today.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c675830%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2fWuQ8IwMn2ncCaid7twqQg&sysid=1 "If you agree with my
vision for our country’s future – an America that is STRONG and PROUD, NOT
WEAK and WOKE – please rush in a donation today.")**

We’ve got a country to save, and with you on my side, that’s exactly what we’re going to do.

---
My very best,

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c675833%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Esb4lcwgu3P%2fG5%2bFEV7drg&sysid=1 "NikkiHaley_Podium")
---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for President of the United States.

I’m running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I’m running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I’m running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I’m doing this for my son who’s a senior in college and shouldn’t have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn’t believe in just to get an A.

I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I’m running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I’ve seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden’s leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a “jobs governor”** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I’ve done it before. **And I’ll do it as your next President. **

As President, I’ll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America’s future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c675834%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=kxopKgI09QdHhqF4M9nBXw&sysid=1 "Will you join me today and
help me save our country?")**

Dear Friends,

A very disturbing story is coming out of rural Virginia right now.

Here's the story from [Fox News](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001gXkSe_UKMFi5GeRPCq_aTFqXmEXyagSZ59ax9bniUdTl5YGfDncQzeBqH49FeUd3650spYoxNq0gSuk2xbgKirErs2n8x-Ep6OhkTK_FYtZNIWZOoPZa5NkB_seDf_87pjzjLCyI0XAei0d8WIfMC0L0N4Tk28Q_VkzuLWMpI1xF_sd1DEdcHjbUBMeDDVxpC1g5fTCX-zuV5hwdwOGw8gwm-s1uSF7CaOLEhYn2VSOwXcZxF2qMVHhr2ggH508EUJimCjCyHnIWGRDiD0kOCAHyopbuGyIahu10sKSSWcfhoBggkseAbJtC4PW4PFfXZmYRlKxvQlZmd_c7tLdsBiag6aUqtciY8ei-xNxl0cS_QSXVWLVRfA==&c=1Wk-j7TDiQcesW1esSEmwAvbvKRCxrA3T1iAatd1jdwG4Yxe5WQzIg==&ch=Z3WHFamPfpZzti3bFhqRFpBQI8YL2-5mwgKFqfj2WFCu9RZvbG5-Aw==)\- "A Virginia teen is refusing a demand from high school officials to remove two American flags from his pickup truck, opting to leave the school altogether instead to be homeschooled. Staunton River High School student Christopher Hartless said he is just exercising his First Amendment rights by flying the flags."

I stand with Christopher Hartless and every student who chooses to show their American pride.

Since when is being patriotic "a distraction?" This is absurd. We live in America and educators SHOULD be educating our students about the importance of the American flag, what it stands for, patriotism and why America was founded as a Constitutional Republic. It's especially disturbing that this is taking place in conservative rural Virginia.

Just shows even in conservative rural Virginia you have to be vigilant as to what your kids are being taught in public schools.

For God & Country,
Amanda Chase

---
Rows of veggies on farms. Your neighbor’s front lawn. The food you eat. A glass of water from the tap.
You may be wondering: what do these things have in common? Well, these are just a few places you might be able to find harmful pesticides like neonicotinoids. Neonics are killing off alarming numbers of bees. And they can harm people, too. But the EPA might still approve them for another 15 years. **[15 more years of neonics would drive vulnerable bees closer to the brink of extinction. Donate $27 today and help protect vulnerable bees and the planet!](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1950796?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)**
Neonics have horrifying impacts. They can **kill bees on contact** after subjecting them to uncontrollable shaking and paralysis. Even if a bee survives, neonics can impact their immune system, navigation, memory, and reproduction. But the harm doesn’t stop with bees. Neonics can impact people, too. From **hormone disruption** to **birth defects of the heart and brain** , the potential effects are serious.
Big Ag has our food system hooked on these toxic pesticides. And the United States EPA could give them a free pass by approving these pesticides for another 15 years. But here’s the deal: neonics are wreaking havoc on bees, people, and the planet. That’s why I’m reaching out to you today, Friend. We can still push the EPA to ban neonics before it’s too late. But we’re up against some powerful corporations. We can’t make a difference without your help. Will you join us in the fight for the future of our planet today?
**We can’t wait 15 more years to ban bee-killing neonics. Help protect bees and the planet and rush your $27 donation today!**
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_
[Donate $27 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1950792?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

[Donate $100 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1950794?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
[Donate another amount](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1950795?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
It’s no secret that we need pollinators for a healthy planet. Without them, some of your favorite nuts, fruits, and veggies could become rarities. Tens of thousands of plant species could die. The disappearance of pollinators would have dire impacts on many ecosystems.
That’s why it’s so disturbing to see the dramatic pollinator declines we’re seeing. In the past few decades alone, **87% of Rusty-Patched bumblebees, 89% of American bumblebees, and 93% of Western bumblebees have disappeared.** American bumblebees have disappeared in several states!
And neonics are a key player driving this crisis. They’re the most widely used insecticides in the world. Even the seeds of our major crops, like corn and soy, are coated with neonics. As a result, acres of our farm fields are toxic to bees. **And the pesticides can’t be washed off the food you eat since _they’re _in_ the food itself._**
Neonics can have serious health impacts for people. They’ve been linked to hormone disruption and autism. But still, chemical companies are contaminating our ecosystems with them for the sake of profits. And we’re seeing the impacts. According to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, about half the U.S. population is exposed to at least one type of neonicotinoid on a regular basis. And the greatest exposures were seen with children just three to five years old!
It's clear that greedy corporations are content to put profit over our planet. If we don’t take action now, there could be devastating consequences for our food system, pollinators, and people.
**Don’t let Big Ag poison pollinators, people, and the planet. Donate $27 now to fight back and help create a future for our only Earth. **
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_
[Donate $27 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1950792?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

---
We’re already paying the price, Friend. The decline in bees and other pollinators has already harmed global fruit, vegetable, and nut production. Without access to these vital crops and a healthy diet, people could be at higher risk of **_heart disease, stroke, diabetes, and even cancer,_** according to a recent study.
We can’t afford to stand aside and let the pesticide industry wreak havoc on our food system. Especially when we’re already seeing disastrous consequences for pollinators, people and our planet. That’s why Friends of the Earth is fighting to hold the pesticide industry accountable. We’re working to transform our farming system so we can protect bees, other precious pollinators, and our planet before it’s too late to make a difference.
Now, the EPA has the chance to ban bee-toxic neonics. But chemical companies have a powerful lobby fighting to keep control of our food system. They’re spending MILLIONS on massive misinformation campaigns to deceive farmers and consumers and suppress the urgent bee-saving solutions we need.
There’s still time to stop these deadly plans. But truthfully, we won’t stand a chance against Big Ag and greedy corporations without support from environmentalists like you. Your membership support today will help fuel our efforts to get toxic pesticides out of our food system and to fight for a future for the planet we call home. Please, be part of the solution that helps us work to protect bees and other pollinators and save our only Earth: Make your $27 membership contribution today!
**Help protect pollinators, people, and the planet before it’s too late: Donate $27 today!**

# Socialism vs. Capitalism (Freedom)
---
People in countries who have the freedom to control their own lives and property have much higher incomes and standards of living than people who live in socialist countries. Much. Higher. Compared to socialist countries, people in free countries have better healthcare, cleaner environments, and far better economic opportunities.
So, the big question is: Why is liberal Dina Titus pushing so hard to move our Country toward socialism?
Answer: The "Elites" in socialist countries do very well. Look how well Putin, Lee, Maduro, The Castro Brothers, and Xi live. While the people of their country struggle in poverty, they live in luxury. The oligarchs and sycophants who surround these corrupt leaders also live very well. In America, the politicians pushing for socialist policies consider themselves part of the "Elite." Look at whom they hang out with: Hollywood stars, billionaires, wealthy political activists, and rich CEOs of American corporations. None of these people fear losing their status in a socialist society. They stand to gain even more power and prestige.
My opponent in 2022, Dina Titus, criticized me for helping people build their own personal "wealth and affluence." At first, I didn't understand her criticism. To me, accumulating wealth is part of the American dream. Most, if not all, Americans want a better life for themselves and their families. What could be wrong with that?
Then it dawned on me.....
Dina and I hold very different philosophies. Dina believes the government should control most of the wealth in our country, while I believe that people should have maximum freedom to build and control their wealth. It is "government control" versus "people control." Said another way, it is....
Socialism versus Capitalism
In socialism, the government makes most economic decisions. Bureaucrats decide what products should be made and what wages should be paid. By contrast, in capitalism, the private sector decides what to make, how much to charge, and how people are paid. Capitalism includes strong protections of property rights so that people have incentives to invest their time, talents, and money into the economy. Socialism removes these incentives.
Socialism has failed everywhere it has been tried. Just think of the plight of people who live in Venezuela or North Korea. Even countries with large economies, such as China and Russia, have much lower living standards than the United States and other free nations.
The more economic freedom that people have, the wealthier they become. Just look at the results. The 2022 Index of Economic Freedom ranks 184 Countries on their degree of freedom. They define economic freedom as "the fundamental right of every human to control his or her own labor and property." Here is a comparison of the average income per person in nine countries. Four of the countries have more economic freedom than the United States and four have less freedom:
---
---
Greater freedom leads to greater prosperity. Those pushing big government spending and socialist policies stand to personally gain at the expense of the American people. We must stand up and fight for our freedoms. History and the facts are on our side.
Use your vote to elect me the Republican candidate who can replace career politician Dina Titus who is only acting in her own self-interest. I will represent you!

Your Questions--Mark's Answers
Mark Robertson answers your questions with direct and honest answers. Here are two questions Mark was asked recently:
Q: One of your competitors in the Primary claimed that he is the ONLY Republican who can beat Dina Titus. What a lie! He also claimed that "Republicans agree" that he is the best candidate to beat Titus. Another lie! I'm a Republican, and I DON'T AGREE! I think people are tired of politicians who lie and say anything just to get elected. -T..J. A. TJ, thank you for your comment. We do need to bring integrity back to the political process. People tell me again and again that they don't trust politicians who make claims that are not true. You can count on me to give you a straight honest answer, even if it's not what you want to hear.
Q. What is your opinion on term limits? -D.B. A. I fully support term limits for members of congress. The authors of the Declaration of Independence and the U.S. Constitution never intended a permanent political class. We need representatives who selflessly serve their country for some time and then return home to live under the laws they enacted. Instead of bragging about being in Washington for 50 years, President Biden should be embarrassed that he never had to live under the laws he passed.
Please share this message with friends and neighbors. Have questions for me? Simply reply to this email to ask me a question.

Those pushing big government spending and socialist policies stand to personally gain at the expense of the American people. We must stand up and fight for our freedoms. History and the facts are on our side. Use your vote to elect me the Republican candidate who can replace career politician Dina Titus who is only acting in her own self-interest. I will represent you! Your Questions--Mark's Answers Mark Robertson answers your questions with direct and honest answers. Here are two questions Mark was asked recently: Q: One of your competitors in the Primary claimed that he is the ONLY Republican who can beat Dina Titus. What a lie! He also claimed that "Republicans agree" that he is the best candidate to beat Titus. Another lie! I'm a Republican, and I DON'T AGREE! I think people are tired of politicians who lie and say anything just to get elected. -T..J. A. TJ, thank you for your comment. We do need to bring integrity back to the political process. People tell me again and again that they don't trust politicians who make claims that are not true. You can count on me to give you a straight honest answer, even if it's not what you want to hear. Q. What is your opinion on term limits? -D.B. A. I fully support term limits for members of congress. The authors of the Declaration of Independence and the U.S. Constitution never intended a permanent political class. We need representatives who selflessly serve their country for some time and then return home to live under the laws they enacted. Instead of bragging about being in Washington for 50 years, President Biden should be embarrassed that he never had to live under the laws he passed. name: Michael B. Moore for South Carolina
subject: "On Message" From Michael B. Moore
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/104585/images/Logo_white_rectangle.jpg]
On Message
from Michael B. Moore
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
Welcome to our campaign newsletter.
We're happy you're here.
We'll use this space to keep you updated on all the latest stories, events and opportunities related to Michael's run for South Carolina's 1st congressional district.
Stay tuned — we'll be in your inbox every Monday.
See you on the trail.
Join our movement [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
In the news
https://www.politico.com/news/2023/07/25/dems-house-majority-the-south-00107401 [https://www.politico.com/news/2023/07/25/dems-house-majority-the-south-00107401]
POLITICO [https://www.politico.com/news/2023/07/25/dems-house-majority-the-south-00107401]
The national media is paying more and more attention to our race every day. Last week, POLITICO [https://www.politico.com/news/2023/07/25/dems-house-majority-the-south-00107401] reported that Democrats "are entertaining a once-unlikely prospect: retaking the House majority by winning in the South."
The story specifically highlighted the SC-01 racial gerrymandering case that will soon come before the Supreme Court [https://www.dailykos.com/stories/2023/7/17/2181780/-My-swing-district-has-its-date-before-the-Supreme-Court] .
Per POLITICO: "It's impossible to know how many seats could become competitive, but the party is hoping a handful may come into play and that new maps could even threaten the likes of ... Nancy Mace."
https://rollcall.com/2023/07/25/many-redistricting-redos-pending-but-24-election-outlook-unclear/ [https://rollcall.com/2023/07/25/many-redistricting-redos-pending-but-24-election-outlook-unclear/]
Roll Call [https://rollcall.com/2023/07/25/many-redistricting-redos-pending-but-24-election-outlook-unclear/]
Roll Call [https://rollcall.com/2023/07/25/many-redistricting-redos-pending-but-24-election-outlook-unclear/] ran a story explaining how new congressional maps "could be drawn in time to change the electoral landscape in 2024, when Democrats need a net gain of just five seats to take control of the House."
According to Roll Call, the SC-01 Supreme Court case "may also impact the federal redistricting litigation in Florida, which involves similar racial gerrymandering claims."
https://charlestoncitypaper.com/2023/07/21/our-view-high-court-should-force-remapping-effort/ [https://charlestoncitypaper.com/2023/07/21/our-view-high-court-should-force-remapping-effort/]
Charleston City Paper [https://charlestoncitypaper.com/2023/07/21/our-view-high-court-should-force-remapping-effort/]
And back home in the Lowcountry, the Charleston City Paper [https://charlestoncitypaper.com/2023/07/21/our-view-high-court-should-force-remapping-effort/] published an editorial calling on the Supreme Court to redraw the lines of SC-01 — so that the map "reflects the true electoral nature of our lower coast, not a district that the GOP bleached by moving thousands of Black voters to other districts."
On the picket line
https://www.dailykos.com/stories/2023/7/25/2183281/-Why-won-t-Nancy-Mace-stand-up-for-these-striking-Waffle-House-workers [https://www.dailykos.com/stories/2023/7/25/2183281/-Why-won-t-Nancy-Mace-stand-up-for-these-striking-Waffle-House-workers]
Union of Southern Service Workers [https://ussw.org/]
Michael expressed solidarity with the workers of the Waffle House on Garners Ferry Road in Columbia, South Carolina, who began a three-day strike [https://twitter.com/RaiseUptheSouth/status/1677737443145949184] on this month after delivering to management their petition to organize.
As a business executive with nearly four decades of private sector experience — including several years as a leader in South Carolina's food industry — Michael knows firsthand that employees throughout any organization deserve fair pay and safe working conditions.
https://holycitysinner.com/2023/07/22/moore-shows-support-for-striking-waffle-house-workers/ [https://holycitysinner.com/2023/07/22/moore-shows-support-for-striking-waffle-house-workers/]
Holy City Sinner [https://holycitysinner.com/2023/07/22/moore-shows-support-for-striking-waffle-house-workers/]
Michael steadfastly stands behind the striking Waffle House staff as they seek sensible concessions from management and strive for a better quality of life for restaurant workers in South Carolina.
He also urged Nancy Mace — who often mentions her past experience as a Waffle House waitress [https://twitter.com/NancyMace/status/1451926458994151427?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw%7Ctwcamp%5Etweetembed%7Ctwterm%5E1451926458994151427%7Ctwgr%5Eb80d1ca7caee292360b8edb17aecebf62c52def8%7Ctwcon%5Es1_&ref_url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.dailykos.com%2Fstories%2F2023%2F7%2F25%2F2183281%2F-Why-won-t-Nancy-Mace-stand-up-for-these-striking-Waffle-House-workers] on the campaign trail — to similarly endorse the demands of those on strike.

Bob Barker, the charming game show host of "Truth or Consequences" and "The Price is Right" [died on Saturday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj71u9CAQAJ8GOp_Wy4-hoPgad_e1KS0My5kEGwujO-Xto0udcjTFaD7uy93nko_Hf7-T66kuPvT8pAXMgGZAsSCPLhEhCU5u1FagABCKb05oZb3SFoIPSYGSOoWAEMNoA6poeXYIKMCgGXEcJdxATNPqrUXyYFQQTALF3Gu7fdZ89I1S-a5PardQd17c1vt5MfGP4cxw9udBr-ut3tB6DoUYzmtdh9W3L2pDJB-HJCctZSSjrZZWr9aAAJ1kiNrClCRvLp6vXEq-9MQkPHafy2-w__3_EwAA__8VjVjH) at age 99. The myth. The best_ ," Sandler wrote, recalling their scene together. "_Such a sweet funny guy to hang out with. Loved talking to him. Loved laughing with him. Loved him kicking the crap out of me_."

He is a member of the House. | Marine Helicopter Crashes, Kills Three A military helicopter carrying U.S. Marines during a drill early Sunday morning on Melville Island in Australia's Northern Territory. The crash killed three U.S. Marines and injured 20, five of whom were transported to Royal Darwin Hospital in serious condition. "Our focus as a government and as a department of defense is very much on incident response and on making sure that every support and assistance is given at this difficult time," Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said. The cause of the crash . Bob Barker Dead at 99 Bob Barker, the charming game show host of "Truth or Consequences" and "The Price is Right" at age 99. In addition to his dapper game show personality, Barker was a dedicated animal rights activist who raised awareness for animal cruelty in the entertainment industry. " I thank you, thank you, thank you for inviting me into your home for more than 50 years," Barker said upon his retirement in June 2007. Adam Sandler, upon hearing the news of Bob Barker's death, paid tribute to his former Happy Gilmore costar : "The man. The myth. The best ," Sandler wrote, recalling their scene together. "Such a sweet funny guy to hang out with. Loved talking to him. Loved laughing with him. Loved him kicking the crap out of me." Other GOP members, such as Chip Roy (R-TX) and Ralph Norman (R-SC) for the move. "I mean, if not now, when?" Norman said over the weekend. The House reconvenes in September. body:

Vivek 2024

America was founded on these truths that we find sacred
and undeniable. Without these truths, our standing as a nation
would mean nothing.

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/os66Xr5DwN

Fellow American,

TRUTH. There's only one. Not
yours, not mine. Just pure TRUTH. In today's bureaucratic
political climate where spin is all the Administrative state
knows how to do, we stand by cold-hard facts. I'm not afraid to
say them:

God is real.
There are two
genders.
Human flourishing
requires fossil fuels.
Reverse racism is
racism.
An open border is no
border.
Parents determine the
education of their children.
The nuclear family is
the greatest form of governance known to mankind.
Capitalism lifts
people up from poverty.
There are three
branches of the U.S. government, not four.
The U.S. Constitution
is the strongest guarantor of freedoms in history.

CHIP IN
IF YOU BELIEVE IN THE TRUTH

America was founded on these
truths that we find sacred and undeniable. Without these truths,
our standing as a nation would mean nothing.

If you agree with these 10
TRUTHS, I need you on my team.

This is about more than a
campaign. It is a movement to revive this great nation. Will you
join me today by chipping in $10 or more?

Thanks,

Vivek Ramaswamy

STAND WITH THE TRUTH

GET TO KNOW VIVEK:

Vivek is an
American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and
New York Times bestselling author of Woke, Inc.: Inside
Corporate America's Social Justice Scam, along with his second
book, Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit,
and the Path Back to Excellence.

He has been a
prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory
practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he
calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes
with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do
through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a
first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he
often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that
"If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be
outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an
accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the
valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate
summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his
J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund,
then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where
his team developed five drugs that went on to become
FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded
Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct
aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and
others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth
of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the
voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading
companies to focus on excellence over politics.

We’re being affected by the summer fundraising slump. If you haven’t heard of it yet, it affects campaigns and non-profit organizations across the country.
The truth is, people are offline as much as possible during the summer. Folks want to take their well-deserved vacations, log off at 5pm, and enjoy the sun — and generally elections seem far, far away.
This month was slower than even we anticipated. **We’re over $35,000 behind on our fundraising goal for this month.**

Kirsten Gillibrand Leads the Charge to Certify the Equal Rights Amendment! Friend: This is incredible news! Kirsten Gillibrand – a bold leader for gender equity – has introduced a new resolution to finally add the Equal Rights Amendment (ERA) to the Constitution! The ERA would classify gender-based discrimination as unconstitutional, giving us a legal basis to restore reproductive rights nationwide. Activists have spent 100 years pushing to add this amendment to the Constitution, and now the required 38 states have finally voted in favor of it. But an arbitrary, unbinding deadline is blocking us from finally adding the 28th Amendment to the Constitution. Kirsten's resolution would allow us to circumvent this deadline and ensure that all Americans are treated fairly under our Constitution, regardless of gender identity. We already know that right-wing extremists will do everything they can to sabotage this resolution – that's why it's so important to know if Americans support the ERA. body:
What an exhilarating week it has been on the campaign trail, as we continue to crisscross this great state of Indiana!

https://www.crouchforindiana.com/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=8541aeaea2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_27_09_26&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8541aeaea2-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Friends and fellow Hoosiers,

What an exhilarating week it has been on the campaign trail, as we continue to crisscross this great state of Indiana! Your unwavering support and enthusiasm are truly humbling, and it fuels our determination to bring about positive change for Hoosiers.

Let's keep the conversation going. Please reach out to share your questions, comments and concerns about Indiana as I️ run for Governor.
EMAIL ME (https://crouchforindiana.com/connect/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=8541aeaea2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_27_09_26&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8541aeaea2-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

** #AxeTheTax Policy Announcement
------------------------------------------------------------

This week, I had the privilege of making a game-changing announcement that will shape the future of Indiana. As your next governor, my commitment to economic prosperity knows no bounds. I firmly believe that hardworking Hoosiers should keep more of their hard-earned money. That's why I'm thrilled to unveil my plan to #AxeTheTax by eliminating the individual income tax.

This plan will pave the way for a brighter and more prosperous future. Together, we will put more money back where it belongs – in the pockets of Hoosier families.
https://vimeo.com/857276631?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=8541aeaea2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_27_09_26&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8541aeaea2-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

** 110th Terre Haute Chamber of Commerce Annual Meeting
------------------------------------------------------------
It was an honor to speak at this prestigious event that celebrates community leaders in the business sector and beyond. The Terre Haute Chamber of Commerce has a rich history of fostering a thriving business environment and creating a community where we can all thrive.

** Vigo County Pachyderm's Annual Ronald Reagan Dinner
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=8541aeaea2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_27_09_26&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8541aeaea2-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

I️ had a wonderful time meeting with Hoosiers at the Vigo County Pachyderm's Annual Ronald Reagan Dinner.

It was also a great opportunity to lay out my plan to eliminate the individual income tax and create a pathway toward greater prosperity. Together, we can build a stronger and more resilient Indiana for all!

** Dedication of Dr. Mary F. Thomas Bridge and State Historic Marker
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=8541aeaea2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_27_09_26&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8541aeaea2-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

We paid tribute to an exceptional woman who left an indelible mark on Indiana's history.

Dr. Mary F. Thomas was not only a pioneering physician but also a suffragist, abolitionist, and Civil War doctor. Her legacy reminds us of the strength and determination of Hoosier women throughout history.

** A Day of Unity and Endorsement
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=8541aeaea2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_27_09_26&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8541aeaea2-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

I had the honor of joining a lively picnic hosted by Rep. J.D. Prescott.

The atmosphere was brimming with energy as we gathered to celebrate the values that bind us together as Hoosiers. It was a wonderful opportunity to connect with all of you and reflect on the path that lies ahead.

I am incredibly humbled to share that during the event, Rep. Prescott took the stage and announced his endorsement of my candidacy for Governor of Indiana! His endorsement is a testament to our shared vision for our beloved state.

** The Lincoln Lawn Party
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=8541aeaea2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_27_09_26&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8541aeaea2-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

It was a pleasure to stand alongside fellow Republican elected officials in Zionsville and share our collective commitment to the principles that make our party strong.

** Speaking to the Second Amendment Patriots
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.facebook.com/CrouchForIndiana?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=8541aeaea2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_27_09_26&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8541aeaea2-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

I had an insightful conversation with the Second Amendment Patriots, discussing my unwavering support for protecting life and our Second Amendment rights. As a Pro-Life advocate, I am dedicated to safeguarding the values that matter most to Hoosiers.

** Last but not least...
------------------------------------------------------------

Thank you for your continued support, for your dedication to our campaign, and for your belief in a brighter future for Indiana. Together, we will forge a path of prosperity, opportunity, and unity that will leave a lasting legacy for generations to come.

Stay tuned for more updates as we press forward on this exciting journey.

Onward and upward,

** Get Involved!
------------------------------------------------------------
Ready to make an impact? By joining my campaign, there are several ways that YOU can be a catalyst for change! Tap the "Get Involved" button below to get hands-on with the campaign, request yard signs, host an event and more.
GET INVOLVED (https://crouchforindiana.com/get-involved/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=8541aeaea2-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_27_09_26&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8541aeaea2-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
You can also attend one of my fundraisers (I️ would love to see you there!)
or make a donation by clicking the "Donate" button at the bottom of this newsletter.

| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won.**

It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

clean_body: Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words. | | | | | | Hi Friend, If you watched the debate, you know why I'm running for president and the solutions I have to offer to get our country back on track. But, whether you've been with me from the start or this is the first time you're hearing about me, I couldn't be more grateful to have you on board. With the first debate kicking this election into high gear, I think it's important to take a few minutes to introduce myself and talk about the journey I have been on. "Once youâ€TMve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!" Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words. | | | | | | I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it. After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: " Don't complain. Do something about it." | | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. | | It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor. When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy. When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them. | I launched my campaign for President over six months ago because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class. Now, I just completed my FIRST debate, and I need a SURGE of support to keep the momentum strong in order to continue sharing this message across America! "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign post-debate. >> " Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will also play a vital role in helping fund our campaign in the upcoming days. Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today in support of my fight to save America? | | | | | | | | | | Friend, throughout my life, I've been shaking up the status quo. I'm hoping to do the same as your next President. But in order to get there, " I need your help â€“ starting right now. " Your support is what keeps our movement thriving, so thank you for standing with me. My very best, | Nikki Haley | | | | | | "NikkiHaleyMerch" | | "Claim Your Mug" | | More About Nikki Haley | "NikkiHaleyPodium" My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States. I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again. I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country. I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A. I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer. I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better. As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor" because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery. At the UN I fought for America, made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names. I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. And I 'll do it as your next President. As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future. [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/46c2f876-bb9f-4907-9211-ec40b1162db9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
_**How Ron DeSantis is Using Bribery To Gain Support For His Presidential Campaign**_
Loomer: Hey, everybody. Welcome to a new episode of Loomer Unleashed. I'm your host, Laura Loomer.
Loomer: And on today's episode, we're going to talk about how the only people who appear to be supporting Ron DeSantis' presidential campaign are people whose support he literally had to pay for.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..C9M1cc4NCFZQpS8n_q95BCUnwwS0kNnpC0t8g-ao33Y?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=136488419)
Loomer: Now, we all know that Iowa is one of the most important states that a GOP candidate for president must win if they want to secure the GOP nomination for president.
Loomer: That is why you've been seeing a lot of the GOP presidential candidates spending a lot of time in Iowa lately.
Loomer: Recently, Tucker Carlson hosted the first GOP presidential forum of the election season.
Loomer: The Forum took place in Iowa, and it was put together by a group called the Family Leader in conjunction with Blaze TV.
Loomer: CEO and president of the Family Leader is a guy by the name of Bob Vander Plaats.
Loomer: Bob Vander Plaats likes to view himself as one of Iowa's leading evangelical Christian leaders, and he also happens to be a three time failed gubernatorial candidate in Iowa, having unsuccessfully run for governor in 2002, 2006, and 2010.
Loomer: But despite being rejected by Iowa voters three times in his bid for governor, Vander Plaats seems to think that he understands what GOP voters in Iowa want and what they're really thinking and what they really want to see in their GOP candidate for president.
Loomer: And if anything is clear, it's the fact that Bob Vander Plaats is completely out of touch with what Iowa GOP voters want.
Loomer: Let's look at who he supported in 2015. Vander Plaats endorsed Ted Cruz for president over Donald Trump in 2016.
Loomer: Vander Plaats has a history of spewing anti-Trump rhetoric.
Loomer: Just take a look at this tweet he posted in 2016 in which he said. "Great job by Marco Rubio and Ted Cruz for exposing Donald Trump. Donald Trump is unprepared and unelectable."
Loomer: Well, Vander Plaats sure ended up eating his words because Donald Trump was certainly electable and went on to serve four years as the greatest president of the United States this country has ever seen.
Loomer: And now as the 2024 presidential election season heats up, Vander Plaats is back to spewing his anti-Trump rhetoric and is supporting candidates who are not Donald Trump.
Loomer: In a July 14th interview with CBS News, Vander Plaats said that Ron DeSantis was the clear alternative to Donald Trump. July 14th happened to be the same exact day that this forum hosted by the Family Leader took place in Iowa.
Loomer: Why does this matter? And why is it of significance that Vander Plaats is supporting Ron DeSantis? Well, what Vander Plaats didn't disclose to the public and what was not disclosed to the American people and was certainly never told to the people of Iowa and attendees of this forum was the fact that on July 3rd, Vander Plaats organization, the Family Leader, received a $50,000 political contribution from the Never Back Down Super PAC.
Loomer: And of course, the Never Back Down Super PAC is the official presidential PAC supporting Ron DeSantis' presidential campaign.
Loomer: Now, Ron DeSantis wasn't the only GOP presidential candidate who attended this forum in Iowa. Donald Trump decided not to attend for good reason, to which he received a lot of negative criticism for it .
Loomer: Republican leaders and TV pundits said that Donald Trump was making a mistake by choosing not to attend this forum.
Loomer: But it looks like Donald Trump made the right decision because, after all, why would Donald Trump want to attend a rigged forum in which the host, Bob Vander Plaats, failed to disclose the fact that he received a $50,000 campaign contribution from the Never Back Down Super PAC just 11 days before hosting this forum with Ron DeSantis.
Loomer: That is the very definition of a conflict of interest and unethical behavior.
Loomer: You see, Ron DeSantis is desperate to make it seem like he has original, organic grassroots support on the ground in Iowa.
Loomer: And that's because Ron DeSantis is not doing so well in the polls. Recent polls conducted this week show that Donald Trump has a nearly 27 point lead over Ron DeSantis in the state of Iowa.

body:
| | | [](http://links.patharriganforcongress.com/u/click?_t=d400fe4f8ca24360a0914af7db39ca7b&_m=e3fb687b08d14bebab382687f6897383&_e=0Akjs5hH1lg6lMMM0upXcaOTsAd_qQSKuQ7meKY-QIm9LeZWg4l8tW2Tjm20MX0sPG1dfOclPn1WikkqjowZSuE7widhkTBadURb7dasehMfhsZOt5XDGdpd_maHJybrOnxMZiNKltFHiQDRip3WubHK155IARw1mG4sWiSarPMuiXEr4tvzKRAp_kzpTL_LrESxOielpBMDCXYK58wZlp7gRr3UqM1hT32_Afz6g83X4FTnGlBE4r9BBHa1-HB8V2C_eg1P5RQQIULNtpGd1vwDOPdBMW5mcmd-E-z3NJKKVnsOj5JLGSdkb5D2ywoTvRs2jk_9KOtZ9ic1IpUd1-MwOI2HIcr4R7uaEOYhZcYCmIcdmQHLLm3TNbaKVN3f)

Fellow American, My name is Pat Harrigan. You don’t know me, but I’m a Green Beret veteran from North Carolina. I graduated from West Point and fought in frontline combat for 18 months in some of the worst conditions on the planet.
---
* During my time on the battlefield of Afghanistan, I received a bronze star for showing leadership and courage in the face of extreme threats.

* I overcame some of the most difficult challenges in my life during my deployment, all because I was shoulder to shoulder with a team of brave Patriotic warriors watching my back.\
k
* When I returned home, I used the team skills I acquired in the Green Berets and my passion for the Second Amendment to create a small business of my own selling firearms.

---
But I believe that my most important accomplishment is my family, I’m the dad of two beautiful girls and the husband of a loving wife.
---
[](http://links.patharriganforcongress.com/u/click?_t=d400fe4f8ca24360a0914af7db39ca7b&_m=e3fb687b08d14bebab382687f6897383&_e=0Akjs5hH1lg6lMMM0upXcaOTsAd_qQSKuQ7meKY-QIm9LeZWg4l8tW2Tjm20MX0sPG1dfOclPn1WikkqjowZSuE7widhkTBadURb7dasehMfhsZOt5XDGdpd_maHJybrOnxMZiNKltFHiQDRip3WubHK155IARw1mG4sWiSarPMuiXEr4tvzKRAp_kzpTL_LrESxOielpBMDCXYK58wZlp7gRr3UqM1hT32_Afz6g82xgfuS7MyyUxqhJ_kOo5yT-OUORCNmjK2JyzZaP0Nir2fMTXbI8NFFxecZo65-hbfLECAG3aifqTh3A6kgbIkZWX2p-LEJSetXoQ5MA1anzev5JBJqHJBz1l4D4DNTncOJCscgvrpDnikAkZMymQ2T)
---
I’m a tried and true leader ready to take on my next great challenge:
---
**I’m officially announcing my run for Congress in North Carolina-14.**
---
[**STAND WITH GREEN BERET PAT HARRIGAN**](http://links.patharriganforcongress.com/u/click?_t=d400fe4f8ca24360a0914af7db39ca7b&_m=e3fb687b08d14bebab382687f6897383&_e=0Akjs5hH1lg6lMMM0upXcaOTsAd_qQSKuQ7meKY-QIm9LeZWg4l8tW2Tjm20MX0sPG1dfOclPn1WikkqjowZSuE7widhkTBadURb7dasehMfhsZOt5XDGdpd_maHJybrOnxMZiNKltFHiQDRip3WubHK155IARw1mG4sWiSarPMuiXEr4tvzKRAp_kzpTL_LrESxOielpBMDCXYK58wZlp7gRr3UqM1hT32_Afz6g80lRfCUT2kKd0xMoI1w7GiPrZGeMI0orDEB-PNepNr1bhw2270h_JAVDxPH12hpfgh_uXkAFqa0iFpdwAXXmPTvN1IFb8w-w_uIS8tj_a9LWzA9ndkFPsvHTqVbYYCTac3p6ryAuW1OOgIrCGTTNEoa)
---
When I came home from combat, I was shocked by how our so-called “leaders” in Washington were treating the American people. Instead of serving the people’s best interests - they have sold themselves out to a group of no-name bureaucrats fueled by greed. Even worse is the radical-Left’s destructive agenda designed to rip apart the societal fabric of America. As a father of girls, it frightens me to imagine the country they’ll be faced with when they’re my age. It doesn’t have to be this way, Fellow American. I’m one of the 10’s millions of American who says this: our country officially hit **code-red****.** We desperately need leadership that puts power BACK into the hands of The People, or we may be doomed. But just like during my time in the Green Berets, I need a top-tier team by my side to help me carry this fight all the way to Washington.

clean_body: | | | Fellow American, My name is Pat Harrigan. You don’t know me, but I’m a Green Beret veteran from North Carolina. I graduated from West Point and fought in frontline combat for 18 months in some of the worst conditions on the planet. During my time on the battlefield of Afghanistan, I received a bronze star for showing leadership and courage in the face of extreme threats. I overcame some of the most difficult challenges in my life during my deployment, all because I was shoulder to shoulder with a team of brave Patriotic warriors watching my back.\ k When I returned home, I used the team skills I acquired in the Green Berets and my passion for the Second Amendment to create a small business of my own selling firearms. But I believe that my most important accomplishment is my family, I’m the dad of two beautiful girls and the husband of a loving wife. I’m a tried and true leader ready to take on my next great challenge: I’m officially announcing my run for Congress in North Carolina-14. When I came home from combat, I was shocked by how our so-called “leaders” in Washington were treating the American people. Instead of serving the people’s best interests - they have sold themselves out to a group of no-name bureaucrats fueled by greed. Even worse is the radical-Left’s destructive agenda designed to rip apart the societal fabric of America. As a father of girls, it frightens me to imagine the country they’ll be faced with when they’re my age. It doesn’t have to be this way, Fellow American. I’m one of the 10’s millions of American who says this: our country officially hit code-red**. We desperately need leadership that puts power BACK into the hands of The People, or we may be doomed. But just like during my time in the Green Berets, I need a top-tier team by my side to help me carry this fight all the way to Washington. Your founding contribution today will help supercharge my race to the finish line. Thank you for your time, and God Bless. With great appreciation, | | Pat Harrigan Special Forces Green Beret Republican for NC | | Paid for by The Pat Harrigan Committee | | Pat Harrigan is a former member of the U.S. Army. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for President of the United States. I’m running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago – an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again. I’m running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something – that we do love this country. I’m running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I’m doing this for my son who’s a senior in college and shouldn’t have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn’t believe in just to get an A. I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer. I’m running for President because we have a country to save! I’ve seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden’s leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better. As governor, I was dubbed a “jobs governor” because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery. At the UN I fought for America, made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names. I know how to make America strong and proud because I’ve done it before. And I’ll do it as your next President. There are only about seven business days left to complete the August call to action! As a reminder, we are asking you to visit your representative’s local office on Thursday, September 7 and deliver two letters while you’re there. They return to D.C. the following week, so the letters need to be delivered before that weekend. If you cannot do it on September 7th, please go any day that you can! The first letter makes the case for opening an impeachment inquiry into Joe Biden’s alleged crimes. The second letter is about the budget and the fiscal year ending September 30. It makes the case against a Continuing Resolution and for the regular appropriations process, so that we can prohibit funding for DOJ’s witch hunt against President Trump and others, as well as include funding for securing the border, etc. We can’t fund policies we want or defund the weaponization we don’t want if they simply agree to a Continuing Resolution. As an example of what could be done by going through the appropriations process, [**see this tweet**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.) from Mike Davis. If you haven’t delivered your letters yet, please [**fill out this** **commitment form**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-DPeA) to let us know you will deliver the letters. **If you already delivered your letters, please** [**fill out this feedback form**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.)**. This is a critically important step so that we know which members have been visited and, if possible, what their positions are on these issues.** Both of the sample letters can be downloaded from the [**page**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-hlHm_xXVhQ) with the commitment form. Make sure to download, customize with appropriate names (and anything else you’d like to add or change), and then print it out. **So, don’t forget to fill out the commitment form if you still need to deliver the letters, and then fill out the feedback form when you’ve done it!**
