[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP59/1/106667/images/unnamed%20%285%29.png]
The foundation of any strong democracy relies on free, fair, and accessible elections. The unsung heroes who ensure this process runs smoothly are our dedicated poll workers and officials.
Unfortunately, these heroes are now facing unprecedented threats that jeopardize both their safety and the integrity of our elections. Protect our election workers by adding your name now! [https://actionnetwork.org/forms/sign-the-petition-protect-election-workers?source=2023ElectionWorkers_BAA&referrer=group-blue-amp-action&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fyyz_ja%3Frefcode%3Dbaa_pet_protectelectionworkersja2308%26amount%3D25]
Add Your Name! [https://actionnetwork.org/forms/sign-the-petition-protect-election-workers?source=2023ElectionWorkers_BAA&referrer=group-blue-amp-action&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fyyz_ja%3Frefcode%3Dbaa_pet_protectelectionworkersja2308%26amount%3D25]
Peter,
Election workers have become the target of online and offline threats that deter them from carrying out their vital duties. These threats have reached alarming levels, driven by the "Big Lie" surrounding the 2020 presidential election. This toxic environment has transformed polling places into political battlegrounds, leading to a record number of election workers quitting their roles.
The situation is dire, and we cannot stand idly by. The safety and security of these individuals are of utmost importance, as they play a pivotal role in upholding the very essence of our democratic process. We’ve got to let them know we have their backs. Add your name now to demand we protect election workers! [https://actionnetwork.org/forms/sign-the-petition-protect-election-workers?source=2023ElectionWorkers_BAA&referrer=group-blue-amp-action&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fyyz_ja%3Frefcode%3Dbaa_pet_protectelectionworkersja2308%26amount%3D25]
ADD YOUR NAME! [https://actionnetwork.org/forms/sign-the-petition-protect-election-workers?source=2023ElectionWorkers_BAA&referrer=group-blue-amp-action&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fyyz_ja%3Frefcode%3Dbaa_pet_protectelectionworkersja2308%26amount%3D25]
Thankfully, initiatives are in motion to counter these threats and ensure the safety of election workers. U.S. Senators Amy Klobuchar and Dick Durbin have reintroduced the Election Worker Protection Act, a crucial step towards enhancing the safety of state and local election officials. This legislation proposes stronger penalties for those who threaten election workers and offers grants for safety improvements.
We must show our unwavering support for those who make our democracy possible. By signing the petition, you're sending a clear message: We stand behind our election workers, and we demand protective measures that enable them to carry out their duties without fear. [https://actionnetwork.org/forms/sign-the-petition-protect-election-workers?source=2023ElectionWorkers_BAA&referrer=group-blue-amp-action&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fyyz_ja%3Frefcode%3Dbaa_pet_protectelectionworkersja2308%26amount%3D25]
SIGN ON! [https://actionnetwork.org/forms/sign-the-petition-protect-election-workers?source=2023ElectionWorkers_BAA&referrer=group-blue-amp-action&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fyyz_ja%3Frefcode%3Dbaa_pet_protectelectionworkersja2308%26amount%3D25]

About BlueAmp Action:
We cannot sugarcoat the current situation. Right-wing authoritarianism, defeated by a worldwide coalition during WWII, was only in hibernation. Over the past decade it has infected democratic societies--including ours. It is as simple as it is terrifying: What we do now will define the future of our country and world.
We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits.
And savvy grassroots activists like you know, just like we do, that we can’t stop watching the people we help elect: after the elections, we have to keep organizing support for the policies we like and pushing back against the ones we don’t.
When the public tunes out between elections and the only people our elected officials hear from are the paid lobbyists of wealthy corporations, our government stops being accountable to the needs of ordinary families.
Democracy never sleeps, and neither can we.
So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. So our kids grow up in democracy, not dystopia.
Thank you for your support for all we do! Please follow Cliff Schecter on Twitter @cliffschecter, or subscribe to The Takedown with Cliff Schecter on YouTube, to keep up to date with this battle for the heart and soul of our country.

subject: The key to Lincoln’s rhetorical success
body:
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills

| This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zi428f3mug1ugrl8ucbelgqr266odbegat0kp4a0_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9imcpr0clh2bs)
---
| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---
| | **Now, the course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or for use in a small group.** **** **You can receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**
Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

| Greater Georgia Newsletter August 28, 2023
Happy August and welcome to this month's Greater Georgia Newsletter! We are thrilled to bring you the latest news and updates from our organization. This month's newsletter is filled with exciting highlights, including a recently launched program that aims to encourage and empower conservatives to run for office at the local level.
---
| |
---
| LATEST NEWS
---
| GREATER GEORGIA COMPLETES 2023 CANDIDATE RECRUITMENT PROGRAM July - August 2023
In July, we [announced](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Y-nRla5rQfZrFWZn97oIJPK3lUjGMITnDUlSBjPnkkRVwJarRpMOgXE39umQvExUCK7e_wdyboIgD2uE0UZa36eJlPzsT-I4h3EJ6SGHX94-M-NGitDx8hyz53njb3JH6gXgsVPrYiBpWvSRETKYRHEERPBTffWEnTCFNAihoMmU6Rar86nmcXUHwyyJIa98&c=OyHHTMhyRxnDs_CAJGsy6ktayhLLfo56Qutn9SZCfQoxj0_gRZT-pA==&ch=sbfcCjFKm6lmXm4MehS8AsnE6O9T9v8uG3omKkiATQotuKHrM2JEeg==) our first-ever candidate recruitment program ahead of the November 2023 municipal elections. The program focused on identifying and recruiting a class of qualified conservatives to run for local office in cities across the state, as well as equipping them with the training to run winning campaigns.
As Senator Loeffler said, "Greater Georgia is going on offense with a program designed to recruit top-tier candidates and empower them with the tools to run and win. By building a strong bench, we'll be better prepared to take back our communities - and deliver strong conservative leadership where it matters most."
Over 100 Georgians signed up to be part of the program, and joined us over the course of this month as we held workshops with experts in fundraising and compliance, field, and conservative policy. Last week was qualifying week for this year's election, and we're thrilled to say that about a dozen individuals in our program qualified to be mayoral and city council candidates in cities across the state. They will be on the ballot for this year's Tuesday, November 7th election - and we'll be publishing their profiles over the coming weeks.
As a reminder, you can begin requesting absentee ballots for the Tuesday, November 7th general election NOW through October 27th. Early voting will begin on October 16th. The voter registration deadline is October 10th.

| STATEMENT ON SB 202 LAWSUIT August 19, 2023
Earlier this month, a [U.S. District Court ruled](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Y-nRla5rQfZrFWZn97oIJPK3lUjGMITnDUlSBjPnkkRVwJarRpMOgXE39umQvExUpBv1aX-yhNNcS543jpxX5_Tg_To6_OkdrdyW5ATroxGve4r7f06yFiWrwAv0AK-vByESbJABQ7oP1Vct4xAdEW1pXKp9yt4umN-0L0KfmQQh1YlZmubVejwxLuqFNdGeqqTqwSE2Z3DtHYlAvzXIU9MAcTPrOAD0oLC0jO-sFFal1QRxuXFSLGBTtHDcEu250j8sWFsUicv4fJhap1TVaA==&c=OyHHTMhyRxnDs_CAJGsy6ktayhLLfo56Qutn9SZCfQoxj0_gRZT-pA==&ch=sbfcCjFKm6lmXm4MehS8AsnE6O9T9v8uG3omKkiATQotuKHrM2JEeg==) to block two provisions of SB 202 - one that bans campaigns and interest groups from influencing voters standing in line to cast their ballots, and one that requires voters to write their date of birth on their absentee ballots for identity verification purposes. Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler issued the [following statement](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Y-nRla5rQfZrFWZn97oIJPK3lUjGMITnDUlSBjPnkkRVwJarRpMOgXE39umQvExUj67sGkevredvoVoAlD98nIPyNPMpHF6JdWqBb4mH8DQqnCpc5f37pJkb3_N-jn5ucfRG-akY-9eLYyT1mtJ9sbyPO3rZFZkmTQ1UCAmgzQifoQMw52Ol8Y7Tstch5Q45bV5I6mPhkVw-j3a6foeRKA==&c=OyHHTMhyRxnDs_CAJGsy6ktayhLLfo56Qutn9SZCfQoxj0_gRZT-pA==&ch=sbfcCjFKm6lmXm4MehS8AsnE6O9T9v8uG3omKkiATQotuKHrM2JEeg==) opposing the Court's ruling, and our team continues to track the progress of this pending litigation.

clean_body: | | | | == | | | Greater Georgia Newsletter August 28, 2023 Happy August and welcome to this month's Greater Georgia Newsletter! We are thrilled to bring you the latest news and updates from our organization. This month's newsletter is filled with exciting highlights, including a recently launched program that aims to encourage and empower conservatives to run for office at the local level. | | | LATEST NEWS | GREATER GEORGIA COMPLETES 2023 CANDIDATE RECRUITMENT PROGRAM July - August 2023 In July, we == our first-ever candidate recruitment program ahead of the November 2023 municipal elections. The program focused on identifying and recruiting a class of qualified conservatives to run for local office in cities across the state, as well as equipping them with the training to run winning campaigns. As Senator Loeffler said, "Greater Georgia is going on offense with a program designed to recruit top-tier candidates and empower them with the tools to run and win. By building a strong bench, we'll be better prepared to take back our communities - and deliver strong conservative leadership where it matters most." Over 100 Georgians signed up to be part of the program, and joined us over the course of this month as we held workshops with experts in fundraising and compliance, field, and conservative policy. Last week was qualifying week for this year's election, and we're thrilled to say that about a dozen individuals in our program qualified to be mayoral and city council candidates in cities across the state. They will be on the ballot for this year's Tuesday, November 7th election - and we'll be publishing their profiles over the coming weeks. As a reminder, you can begin requesting absentee ballots for the Tuesday, November 7th general election NOW through October 27th. Early voting will begin on October 16th. The voter registration deadline is October 10th. | == | | | STATEMENT ON SB 202 LAWSUIT August 19, 2023 Earlier this month, a == to block two provisions of SB 202 - one that bans campaigns and interest groups from influencing voters standing in line to cast their ballots, and one that requires voters to write their date of birth on their absentee ballots for identity verification purposes. Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler issued the == opposing the Court's ruling, and our team continues to track the progress of this pending litigation. | == | | | IN THE MEDIA Live Interview with Erick Erickson at The Gathering August 18, 2023 Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler joined Erick Erickson at The Gathering Conference to discuss our latest work at Greater Georgia and the importance of year-round voter registration, mobilization, and education - especially for diverse communities, young voters, and women. The two also dug into the key issues driving the electorate - and what it will take to keep Georgia red in 2024. Meanwhile, our team spent the weekend registering voters and recruiting volunteers from the fired-up audience. Click == or the image below to watch the interview. | == | | | | | Radio Interview with Martha Zoller on WDUN August 4, 2023 Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler joined Martha Zoller to discuss the success of our candidate recruitment program and the importance of proactive conservative recruitment at the local level. Click == or the image below to listen to the segment. | == | | | Newsmax Op-Ed on Saving Girls's Sports July 24, 2023 Last month, Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler also published a == exposing top women athletes' hypocrisy in pushing for boys in girls' sports - the very platform on which stars like Megan Rapinoe built gold-plated careers. As a former co-owner of the WNBA Atlanta Dream and a Presidential Delegate to the FIFA 2019 Women's World Cup, Loeffler also called on women's professional sports leagues to stand up for the advancement of girls' sports by rejecting gender ideology and preserving a level playing field for future generations. Click == or on the image below to read the full op-ed. | == | | | EVENTS 8th Congressional District Fish Fry August 26, 2023 This weekend, Greater Georgia was proud to sponsor the 20th Annual 8th District Fish Fry at the Georgia National Fairgrounds in Perry. We had an excellent time meeting with friends from across South Georgia, hearing from Governor Brian Kemp and Congressman Austin Scott - and of course, eating fried fish! | | | | | | Citizen Impact Annual Conference August 24, 2023 ==, we were also thrilled to join Citizen Impact for their 2023 Annual Conference, where conservatives from across the state gathered to discuss faith, family, and freedom - and how to defend it in 2024. | | | | | Sound of Freedom Event with Governor and First Lady Kemp August 8, 2023 ==, Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler was joined by Governor Kemp, First Lady Kemp, and supporters for a showing of Sound of Freedom. It was a somber way to spread awareness about the epidemic of child exploitation - and to call attention to the First Family's tremendous efforts in the fight to end human trafficking. | == | | | Summer Canvassing Spree in Gwinnett County August 5, 2023 ==, we hosted a canvassing event in Gwinnett County. It’s where I was born and raised, went to school, met my husband, and raised our three sons. What an honor and responsibility it is to serve the communities I’ve called home my entire life.

So it wasn’t a surprise when I heard my eldest brother Bob (Jr.) was helping connect folks to my office for support with federal services.

name: Nikki Haley
subject: I want to share this with you
body:
Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.

| |
---
| | | | [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2ztmqcegt01lirktuo2dakecnklqjrvecvtqchb68_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9im2p75cdh2bs)
---

Hi Friend,

If you watched the debate, you know why I'm running for president and the solutions I have to offer to get our country back on track.

But, whether you've been with me from the start or this is the first time you're hearing about me, I couldn't be more grateful to have you on board.

With the first debate kicking this election into high gear, I think it's important to take a few minutes to introduce myself and talk about the journey I have been on. **[Once you've finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z9cqou0ka0qrqpi0ntlgrlctkdnqplt08equp00o_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9im2p75cdh2bs "Once youâ€TMve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
| | | | | [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zaci076k5n6a00dj4omreqkp74iu2nrk6665p0u0_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9im2p75cdh2bs)
---
| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won.**
---
| | [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zu8ipp6fv3ciu83ad8s9ma9bnfp3lf16qjpmrsv0_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9im2p75cdh2bs)
---
It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

---
| [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z96i7idbf4nqotosc29jcj3e2pj58cnspe23ecto_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9im2p75cdh2bs)
---

I launched my campaign for President over six months ago because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class.

Now, I just completed my **FIRST** debate, and I need a **SURGE** of support to keep the momentum strong in order to continue sharing this message across America! **[It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign post-debate.>>](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zti67r4tri3pnp4o81dkr8vcgu72vt04p9nor14o_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9im2p75cdh2bs "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign post-debate.")**

Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will also play a vital role in helping fund our campaign in the upcoming days.

Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today in support of my fight to save America?

---
| | [CHIP IN $5](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z62nqn8cejjngegkfumf0d9s3qqgiir1fcsa86d0_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9im2p75cdh2bs)
---

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

subject: I want to share this with you
body:
Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.

| |
---
| | | | [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zf3f0r75g6kb43tjrf03isu9b714hcchnrntf8s8_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9imapb2c5h2bs)
---

Hi Friend,

If you watched the debate, you know why I'm running for president and the solutions I have to offer to get our country back on track.

But, whether you've been with me from the start or this is the first time you're hearing about me, I couldn't be more grateful to have you on board.

With the first debate kicking this election into high gear, I think it's important to take a few minutes to introduce myself and talk about the journey I have been on. **[Once you've finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zrghea8ui53a4kg36i1vep0nkh6ur1kb2a8afdbo_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9imapb2c5h2bs "Once youâ€TMve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
| | | | | [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z7uc7ntdvgkhspu7a8scinh20r32sr6f70d9kjjg_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9imapb2c5h2bs)
---
| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won.**
---
| | [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2znehcq2ksp431s619h7h66v6fvsmc579nt47bcoo_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9imapb2c5h2bs)
---
It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

---
| [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zu167oh66g8doin6nsg032s4bk9lohv1a3rpm1h0_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9imapb2c5h2bs)
---

I launched my campaign for President over six months ago because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class.

Now, I just completed my **FIRST** debate, and I need a **SURGE** of support to keep the momentum strong in order to continue sharing this message across America! **[It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign post-debate.>>](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zj73i7vhgj69dirb4hbf0s4afgot0bir4mtfeo30_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9imapb2c5h2bs "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign post-debate.")**

Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will also play a vital role in helping fund our campaign in the upcoming days.

Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today in support of my fight to save America?

---
| | [CHIP IN $5](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zf832ss0havd45cnq0qpqg4an3kl9ho7go8j5lt0_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9imapb2c5h2bs)
---
| | [CHIP IN $25](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zft5kcnugtjhn0699goq21q5fc0ka98c648d5meg_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9imapb2c5h2bs)
---
| | [CHIP IN $50](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z15av6i38dfjpe36jvh9fn841vsscfgt14cb6f58_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9imapb2c5h2bs)
---
| | [CHIP IN $150](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zi76m975r2n2veeh16ofc4oglhv06p26qf59d8a8_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9imapb2c5h2bs)
---
| | [CHIP IN ANY OTHER AMOUNT](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z4pkt23rujqufl8ff4ncsca81vqhfjkqh267s1r0_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9imapb2c5h2bs)
---

Friend, throughout my life, I've been shaking up the status quo. I'm hoping to do the same as your next President. But in order to get there, **[I need your help to make it across the finish line- starting right now.](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zjg7goissck0fcactorn1577uu5fg3mj75jbbuk0_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9imapb2c5h2bs "I need your help â€“ starting right now. ")**

Your support is what keeps our movement thriving, so thank you for standing with me.

My very best,

---
| [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z0tid9o2csumsu2n22k653kiaa1dqhtur75pjdlo_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9imapb2c5h2bs)

Nikki Haley
---
| | | | |
---
| [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zb1vn772jc03c32bjr2f9ccbhi61070jbdh2ni18_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9imapb2c5h2bs "NikkiHaley_Merch")
---
| | [GET YOUR HAT NOW](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zvo7p8v33jiusuuk66ddtfjs0fobslkeo0jlhn60_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9imapb2c5h2bs "Claim Your Mug")
---
---
| | **More About Nikki Haley**

---
| [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zmputbf0htm2epauokp858jpb610lrsh2r0nb8u0_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9imapb2c5h2bs "NikkiHaley_Podium")
---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zl2i3cgvus69tbt4c7cr5lr3gkkmafkkquf20sng_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9imapb2c5h2bs "Will you join me today and help me save our country?")**

subject: The most personal email I’ll ever send you
body:
I never thought that my own government would spy on me.

[](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zgb5g1lldcmonenecf10dlosrsviisgf6n4l6a7g_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9imao76c3h2bs)

Hello Friend,

I never thought that my own government would spy on me.

I have always loved my country.

That's why I've dedicated my life to being a public defender, a federal prosecutor, and a legal liaison to the United States Armed Forces. I believe in the foundational values of America - life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness.

So when Devin Nunes asked me to help with the Russiagate investigation, I told him whatever we discovered about President Trump, _good or bad_ , it had to be published.

When I started my investigation, I hadn't even met President Trump. **But this investigation changed my life forever ...**

_Trump did NOT collude with Russia_.

**My investigation discovered the FBI 's unlawful investigation. And what I found makes me believe that they did it _intentionall_ y to get rid of President Trump.**

It's why I refer to the Russia Gate FBI cabal as government gangsters. They are crooks who abuse their power to extort our elected officials. Their deep connections with the media enable a manufacturing machine of fake news.

Once I found the truth, that's when the spying began...

Since then, I knew I had to do everything to help American patriots by offering financial assistance to whistleblowers, veterans, patriots, and some families of Jan 6 detainees.

As a former federal prosecutor, I know that we need protection if we are going to expose corrupt government gangsters.

I set a goal to raise **$45,000** by the end of the week, and we're behind in reaching that goal.

[As a personal favor, will you donate $10, $35, $50, or any amount to support these freedom fighters? Click here to rush your support before the deadline >>>](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zjmfk9djvnnk17pke55fa2u86cioh0tj1b5i2qj0_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9imao76c3h2bs)

Conservatives, America-First patriots, or anyone who believes that Americans are **innocent** until proven guilty must join together in this fight.

Some of the Jan 6 detainees have become victims of the abuses outlined above, and we cannot leave them in solitary confinement within the D.C. prison system.

**This two-tiered justice system is a complete sham and a mockery of our constitution.**

Due process has been destroyed.

**We cannot let the justice system be hijacked and used against us. **

[I am humbly asking for your support. Join me in the fight for justice in defending patriots against abuse of the justice system by clicking here >>>](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zqtkrkmg0tkpjjlc0t7m33bl525tapdp28as17uo_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9imao76c3h2bs)

Trump and the Jan 6 defendants are only the beginning. The radical left has weaponized the justice system against America-first patriots.

Whether you're a whistleblower exposing deep state corruption, a parent protesting against trans ideology in our schools, or a pro-life activist praying outside of abortion clinics, the justice system can be used against you. We need an organization to defend our supporters, and that's what Kash Foundation is doing.

name: Nikki Haley
subject: what’s next
body:
If you watched the debate, you know we’re ready...

| |
---
| | |
---
| | |
Friend,

If you watched the debate, you know we're ready...Ready to move past the stale ideas and faded names of the past...and we are more than ready for a new generation to lead us into the future!

I'm writing to you today with a vision of that future - **[and how we can achieve that vision, together.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z8knor8jm6uo5cvg5h84pv5ugitmmc4bdc98s3vo_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9imao74slh2bs "and how we can achieve that vision, together.")**

I see a strong America - _full of opportunity, that lifts up everyone._

I see a proud America - _confident in who we are, and what we stand for._

And I see America leading the world - _in freedom and peace._

**I 'm running for President to make this vision a reality.** _**[It would mean the world to know you're on my side. If you have $1 or more to spare, I'm hoping you will pitch in a generous contribution to my campaign today.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zlgvfgtbp5e2i3brtqcsodds9fhlejug5jvsthlo_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9imao74slh2bs "It would mean the world to know you’re on my side. If you have $1 or more to spare, I’m hoping you will pitch in a generous contribution to my campaign today.")**_

The America I see will win the fight for the 21st Century. _And, we won 't win the fight for the 21st Century if we keep trusting politicians from the 20th Century._

The America I see has the courage and confidence to **defend our values** and **defeat our enemies.**

In this America, the Armed Forces of the United States will be stronger and more innovative and capable than ever.

In this America, we'll start pumping more oil and gas - and stop buying dirty oil from Venezuela.

We'll stand with our allies - from Israel to Ukraine - and stand up to our enemies - in Iran and Russia.

And in the America I see, Communist China won't just lose...

Like the Soviet Union before it, the tyranny of its system will land the Communist Chinese government on the ash-heap of history!

Realizing this vision won't be easy. **[It will take an unparalleled level of commitment from all of us.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zrvbh1sj6tbg7700g2gppr019g1cgv89ob8agqqo_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9imao74slh2bs "It will take an unparalleled level of commitment from all of us.")**

It requires faith and a willingness to move past the status quo. It will require each and every one of you to know - you can't complain about what you get in a general election if you don't play in this primary.

We need someone who can shake up Washington and the political class.

I've done it before, and I'll do it again. I need your help to get there.

**[Please consider chipping in a special donation of $20.24 or more to my campaign today to help us continue to build a surge of momentum and save our country.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zdc1uqo9frh5hgpcn4urod662cldvj640h642lb8_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9imao74slh2bs "Please consider chipping in a special donation of $20.24 or more to my campaign today to help us continue to build a surge of momentum and save our country.")**
|
_Thank you in advance._

My very best,

subject: What a night!

body:
Did you see the debate?

| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z0mamj8rrnggq3ntc4cit0vhd7gek65uuuaofa18_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9im6ob6c9h2bs)
Fellow American,

When I stepped off the stage, I could feel electricity in the air. _This campaign has built tremendous momentum and we aren't letting up for a minute._

For those of you who have been with me since the beginning, you know how big tonight's victory is. We started this campaign back in late February polling at 0.0%. My vision is for an America more unified by our founding ideals than torn apart by our perceived differences.

|
**God** is real.
There are **two** genders.
Human flourishing requires **fossil fuels**.
**Reverse racism** is racism.
An open border is **no border**.
**Parents** determine the education of their children.
The **nuclear family** is the greatest form of governance known to mankind.
**Capitalism** lifts people up from poverty.
There are three branches of the U.S. government, **not four**.
The **U.S. Constitution** is the strongest guarantor of freedoms in history.
| [** JOIN OUR MOVEMENT **](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zgi4541uu5dkv32ttj6p7t91kkicc7046c7l4nh0_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9im6ob6c9h2bs)
---

My Republican opponents offered a lot of great points tonight but here's why my campaign is different:
* I'm going to revolutionize the way our government is run. _The people who we elect to run the government are NOT the ones who actually run the government_. It's the managerial class in the Deep State. You cannot reform these agencies. The only answer is to **SHUT THEM DOWN** , and I am the only presidential candidate who has the plan on how to actually do it.
* We have got to change the conversation. Stop talking about Biden & start talking about what we actually stand for as Republicans. Spouting off poll-tested platitudes about Biden makes us sound like partisan hacks. And that's exactly why it's going to take an outsider from a new generation to get the job done.
* I don't want a national divorce, and other candidates are pushing us toward the brink of that division. I'm running to lead us to a national revival. If we can revive that, then nobody in the world - not a nation, not a corporation, not a virus - will defeat us.

**[Fellow American, I hope you are ready to join me and fight for the future of America. There are 20 weeks until the first primary election. Chip in $20 today and together, let's make America our first priority.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zr8edljsqrq9ph7qg8muq2mkvgg4am4r6e24k1j8_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9im6ob6c9h2bs)**

_Fellow American - are you ready for the revolution?_

America First,

[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zn80765n10u797bbufhu0jlvn29fiaimj4p9a808_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9im6ob6c9h2bs)
Vivek Ramaswamy

[** JOIN OUR MOVEMENT ->**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zg13i7soql6ff6aqm2pg95udpsr8d8ph8cdosntg_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9im6ob6c9h2bs)
---

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

name: Nikki Haley
subject: what’s next
body:
If you watched the debate, you know we’re ready...

| |
---
| | |
---
| | |
Friend,

If you watched the debate, you know we're ready...Ready to move past the stale ideas and faded names of the past...and we are more than ready for a new generation to lead us into the future!

I'm writing to you today with a vision of that future - **[and how we can achieve that vision, together.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zu7or46fgj14p97mcbr8hvbr5179uec5pd20bnbo_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9im6ob2cph2bs "and how we can achieve that vision, together.")**

I see a strong America - _full of opportunity, that lifts up everyone._

I see a proud America - _confident in who we are, and what we stand for._

And I see America leading the world - _in freedom and peace._

**I 'm running for President to make this vision a reality.** _**[It would mean the world to know you're on my side. If you have $1 or more to spare, I'm hoping you will pitch in a generous contribution to my campaign today.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zql165i1tcj17ohji70kvkrdp06044im81g0cs88_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9im6ob2cph2bs "It would mean the world to know you’re on my side. If you have $1 or more to spare, I’m hoping you will pitch in a generous contribution to my campaign today.")**_

The America I see will win the fight for the 21st Century. _And, we won 't win the fight for the 21st Century if we keep trusting politicians from the 20th Century._

The America I see has the courage and confidence to **defend our values** and **defeat our enemies.**

In this America, the Armed Forces of the United States will be stronger and more innovative and capable than ever.

In this America, we'll start pumping more oil and gas - and stop buying dirty oil from Venezuela.

We'll stand with our allies - from Israel to Ukraine - and stand up to our enemies - in Iran and Russia.

And in the America I see, Communist China won't just lose...

Like the Soviet Union before it, the tyranny of its system will land the Communist Chinese government on the ash-heap of history!

Realizing this vision won't be easy. **[It will take an unparalleled level of commitment from all of us.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zc19dg8702g887dg42np0oq4p5nrvrtul4o8jos8_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9im6ob2cph2bs "It will take an unparalleled level of commitment from all of us.")**

It requires faith and a willingness to move past the status quo. It will require each and every one of you to know - you can't complain about what you get in a general election if you don't play in this primary.

We need someone who can shake up Washington and the political class.

I've done it before, and I'll do it again. I need your help to get there.

**[Please consider chipping in a special donation of $20.24 or more to my campaign today to help us continue to build a surge of momentum and save our country.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zjn3sch6rkjrsrl6mcmknsjc33gap3a03stk77i0_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9im6ob2cph2bs "Please consider chipping in a special donation of $20.24 or more to my campaign today to help us continue to build a surge of momentum and save our country.")**
|
_Thank you in advance._

My very best,

body:
| I can't do it alone.
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=1060%2E35263%2EipIyvv)
Peter, When I ran for Senate in 2012, a lot of powerful people didn’t think I had a shot. But this incredible grassroots team fought alongside me — even as others wrote us off. With your help, I became the first woman elected to the U.S. Senate from our state and the first openly gay Senator in our nation’s history. I didn’t run to make history, however, I ran to make a difference in people’s lives. That’s what I’ve been hard at work doing every day since — especially in the fight to protect and expand LGBTQ+ rights. **But across the country right now, extreme Republicans are working overtime to advance a wave of anti-LGBTQ+ legislation.** They are targeting transgender youth in particular, trying to roll back their rights and freedoms. **I refuse to be discouraged.** I ran for office to make a difference, and I won't let anti-LGBTQ+ Republicans turn back the clock. I'm going to keep fighting for our fundamental rights and freedoms, but I can't do it alone. **[Peter, pitch in any amount you can spare to defend our Democratic majority. We can't let Republicans take back the Senate and continue their crusade to roll back our rights and freedoms.](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-aug23.ECUt09&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20230828_AM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=1060%2E35263%2EipIyvv)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | [CHIP IN $5 NOW](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2150?c0=tbe-em-aug23.ePE894&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20230828_AM1_V1_S1&t=5&akid=1060%2E35263%2EipIyvv)

| | **For Immediate Release:** August 28, 2023
**Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com) **Organized Labor Backs Dave Min For Congress**
_The Orange County Labor Federation Votes To
Recommend Sen. Dave Min For California’s 47th_ **Irvine, CA** – Today, Dave Min for Congress announced that the Orange County Labor Federation has voted to recommend the endorsement of his campaign by the AFL-CIO to represent California’s 47th Congressional District. This massively important announcement definitively cements Dave Min as the candidate of labor in this race, following months of key early endorsements from national, statewide and local unions, including the Service Employees International Union, the California Federation of Teachers, the Los Angeles Police Protective League, International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers Locals 47 & 441, Teamsters Joint Council 42, National Union of Healthcare Workers, United Food and Commercial Workers Local 324, International Union of Painters and Allied Trades District Council 36, and Orange County Employees Association. **“The Orange County Labor Federation is proud to recommend Dave Min for California’s 47th Congressional District,”** said Gloria Alvarado, Executive Director of OCLF. **“Dave is a fighter for Orange County’s working families. We are confident he can win this seat and fight for working families in Washington. We’re thrilled to work together in helping Dave keep CA-47 in our column.”** Chartered in 1929 by the AFL-CIO, the Orange County Labor Federation is the official regional body that brings together unions from different sectors to fight for decent wages, safe working conditions, strong communities, and upward mobility for our communities. The OCLF represents more than ninety local unions from every sector of the labor movement with a membership of more than 200,000 working members. The AFL-CIO is the largest federation of unions in the United States. It is made up of 60 national and international unions, and represents more than 12 million active and retired workers. Min adds the Labor Federation to an impressive and diverse coalition of support. After entering the race with the endorsement of incumbent Rep. Katie Porter, Min has consolidated support from local, state, and national officials and organizations. In recent months, Min has announced the endorsements of California Lieutenant Governor Eleni Kounalakis, Attorney General Rob Bonta, State Treasurer Fiona Ma, Insurance Commissioner Ricard Lara, Superintendent of Public Schools Tony Thurmond, the Congressional Asian Pacific American Caucus’s political leadership ASPIRE PAC, more than 50 local Orange County government officials, and more than 60 state legislators. A full endorsement list is available [here](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=539baa8206&e=7017cc100e). The OCLF’s recommendation is welcome support heading into 2024. California’s 47th is widely seen as one of the most competitive seats in the country. Incumbent Rep. Katie Porter defeated Scott Baugh last year by just over 3%. Baugh is the likely Republican nominee, and will face Porter’s pick in Dave Min next November, during a cycle where the national GOP has declared CA-47 their top target. But Dave Min is no stranger to tough races. He currently represents over 80% of the 47th Congressional District in the State Senate, and won CA-47 during that election by over 5% in 2020, a tough year for Orange County Democrats, defeating a long-time Republican icon who was thought to be unbeatable. name: Pro Life Update
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zesc5b47tn69h94sn1rru875ga1r79flnqqhe4ug_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9im1oj0clh2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.”
Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zqk95lk2ng3g7676o0h6n3hsi9j7q52g8shl2a10_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9im1oj0clh2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of “**The Second World Wars** ” on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zel99tomo0286qh15ivk57cts41l051fuo2jdcq8_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9im1oj0clh2bs)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!

| This week we must show respect and observance of the two-year anniversary since an ISIS-K terrorist detonated a suicide bomb in Kabul during the U.S. military withdrawal from Afganistan. We will never forget the selfless sacrifice of Nebraska Marine Cpl. Daegan Page, one of our 13 fallen heroes.
---
| [ ](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=2383c1b468&e=25844e23a8)

| Daegan William-Tyeler Page was born in Omaha on February 6, 1998, and after living his first five years in Iowa, his family moved to Omaha where he graduated from Millard South High School in 2016. In January 2018, he left Omaha for Boot Camp in San Diego. After multiple deployments around the world, Page gave the ultimate sacrifice in Afghanistan trying to help people escape the Taliban takeover at the airport in Kabul.

We must never forget Daegan’s sacrifice.

We must also never give up on the call for transparency and accountability for our 13 fallen heroes and their families.

Respectfully,

Eric Underwood - Chairman
Republican Party of Nebraska

We will never forget the selfless sacrifice of Nebraska Marine Cpl. Daegan Page, one of our 13 fallen heroes. | | Daegan William-Tyeler Page was born in Omaha on February 6, 1998, and after living his first five years in Iowa, his family moved to Omaha where he graduated from Millard South High School in 2016. In January 2018, he left Omaha for Boot Camp in San Diego. After multiple deployments around the world, Page gave the ultimate sacrifice in Afghanistan trying to help people escape the Taliban takeover at the airport in Kabul. We must never forget Daegan’s sacrifice. We must also never give up on the call for transparency and accountability for our 13 fallen heroes and their families. | | My Sisters and Brothers, today marks the 60-year anniversary of the historic March on Washington. The demands we called for on August 28, 1963 are not so different from what we call for today: voting rights, fair wages, and real equality for every American. Now, six decades after 250,000 Americans marched in support of equality for all, the current GOP has sought to bitterly divide us on which version of history we teach today’s students. At a time when white extremism is on a sharp rise across our nation, we must continue to rise up and make our voices heard, rejecting their agenda and their propaganda. And we must double our efforts, ensuring that the American dream is achievable for everyone! [The legacy of the March on Washington carries on through us, and we will not be silenced!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68798857/424187810/1011771453?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS85MzczOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZjhhNjY4OC1jYzQ1LWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=X64rPHN6eibNKdpU50edXbjrJAQCKSjeDXfQIb-8l0A=&emci=e1393180-cb45-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&emdi=cf8a6688-cc45-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&ceid=1486204)

It's been a few years, and many of myformer students are now young adults in a world where it's harder to get a good-paying job, find an affordable place to live, and feel optimistic about our politics. Advocating for kids like them sent me from the classroom to the courtroom to the school board room where I have been a leader on not just education — but on climate change, infrastructure, food insecurity, gun violence prevention and more. It's evident that we have to do more, and quickly, to ensure safe communities, good-paying jobs, and quality health care for everyone. I am ready to continue his fight in the House to protect reproductive freedom, take on the fossil fuel industry to fight climate change, and bring home the resources California needs to take on the crisis of housing insecurity. It was only a few months ago that a Trump-appointed federal judge in Texas blocked the FDA's approval of mifepristone – a widely-used abortion drug that's been available for _over twenty years_. The Supreme Court later put this outrageous ruling on hold. But the anti-choice right hasn’t let up in their efforts to use the judiciary to implement national abortion restrictions.

Just this month, a conservative-leaning federal appeals court ruled in favor of limiting access to mifepristone. This decision is not yet in effect (pending Supreme Court review), but it would prevent the drug from being taken later in pregnancy, and not allow it to be mailed directly to patients.

We want to emphasize something that’s truly outrageous: **the restrictions to mifepristone would apply to _all_ states – including ones like Virginia that still recognize the right to choose.**

This is all part of the far right’s plan to institute a national abortion ban. They can’t get the necessary votes to do it through Congress, and they certainly can’t win the argument at the ballot box, so they’re aiming to circumvent the will of the people and use right-wing courts.

**Jennifer refuses to sit by and let that happen.** She understands that Congress has to step up and pass legislation that protects access to abortion medication like mifepristone.

[**Please, will you join her and add your name to amplify her call to action? He spends more time on Twitter than he does working for Texans | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/f8ea7a8ae350/a-new-way-forward-for-texas-12647769?e=b8ba94fd9b)
---
As school districts across Texas come back into session, let’s take a moment to better understand how Thierry thinks about funding schools, as compared to Ted Cruz.
Recently, Thierry tweeted that defunding public schools is an insult to Texas students & teachers. He promised that as your next Democratic U.S. Senator, he’ll work to bring as much federal funding to our public schools as possible.
[](https://tchenkofortexas.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=93f02de4b9a588e8269491419&id=70a8c7c3d5&e=b8ba94fd9b)
Seems like a pretty common sense pledge, if you actually care about the children and working families of Texas.
But, if you’re Ted Cruz and your mind has been steeped in right-wing propaganda for so long that you can no longer tell up from down, this simple statement was proof of some sinister plot to destroy the future of “low-income Black & Hispanic kids trapped in failing schools.”
[](https://tchenkofortexas.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=93f02de4b9a588e8269491419&id=61401667b7&e=b8ba94fd9b)
Thierry of course responded to Ted’s absurd claim, asking him to please explain how funding public schools was somehow bad for... *checks notes*... public schools and the children who attend them.
**Thierry also made it clear that this was a debate he was willing to have with Ted** _**(anywhere, anytime)**_**. Because our children deserve nothing less.**
[](https://tchenkofortexas.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=93f02de4b9a588e8269491419&id=910dc6f083&e=b8ba94fd9b)
Ted’s response: _silence._
Because extreme right-wing talking points are fine, but they can only get you so far.
**Ted Cruz is all too comfortable throwing punches on Twitter, but he’s not working for the people of Texas. And he hasn’t been for far too long.**

subject: What it means to fight

body:

| Peter -
Every day, Americans feel the impact of Joe Biden's failures as president.
Our paychecks have been diminished under inflation caused by overspending and government waste.
Our communities have been devastated by fentanyl, a poison trafficked into our country through a porous border by the Mexican drug cartels.
Our electricity bills and gas prices have skyrocketed while Joe Biden attacks American oil and gas production.
It's critical that we understand and articulate the problems that we face, because those problems are real. But it's far more important that we put forth solutions to these problems, otherwise we are just complaining.
That's why I've spent my time in Congress proposing sensible policies that would address the root causes of the challenges facing Americans under Joe Biden's failed leadership.
I helped pass legislation to rein in federal spending and stop the abuse of America's welfare programs.
I've taken on the Mexican Drug Cartels who are killing Americans with fentanyl, and introduced legislation to thwart illegal immigration and secure our southern border.
And, as a Texan who comes from an oil and gas family, I've stood up for American energy independence by passing bills to protect our critical fossil fuel industry from frivolous environmental lawsuits.
This is what it means to fight. It's not just enough to point out the failures of this president and the extreme party he leads - you have to offer a better path forward for the country we love. Not with shallow rhetoric. Not by yelling and screaming on cable news. But by spending the time to understand the issues that matter, take the time to craft policy related to those issues, and put the effort into turning policy ideas into law through the legislative process and communicating those ideas to the American people.

It's clear as day that Democrats are more fired up than ever to elect pro-choice women.

We've seen Democratic pro-choice women defeat Republicans nationwide; anti-choice ballot initiatives have been overwhelmingly rejected by voters in not-so-blue states like Kansas and Ohio; Wisconsin elected pro-choice champion **Janet Protasiewicz** to their state Supreme Court (with EMILYs List's support!); and state leaders are fighting hard to pass pro-choice ballot measures.

**I've seen this kind of grassroots energy before — back in 1992**. That was the year EMILYs List grew our membership by 600%, elected four new women to the Senate, and elected _20_ to the House. It quickly became known as the "Year of the Woman."

**Well, guess what? I think 2024 is about to be the "Year of the Woman" all over again.** **[Americans overwhelmingly agree with our pro-choice values — no doubt about it. We just need more resources to recruit, train, and support candidates to make those values into policy. So I'm personally asking: Will you support EMILYs List today by chipping in toward our $150,000 End-of-Month goal?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/68800493/424193536/1205285870?sourceid=1051804&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ODEzMzE4Yy1jZjQ1LWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wB-XM-WsIh4LWKvBFfVonymRDNB_zDlSVPHI36t4aqE=&emci=c47729d0-8343-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&emdi=5813318c-cf45-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&ceid=5177934)**

I've seen a lot as the founder of EMILYs List. We were a much smaller organization in 1992, organizing to defeat anti-choice extremists, and women nationwide were inspired to get involved and demand better representation.

Today, it's been over a year since the ultraconservative Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ and obliterated national abortion rights. Twenty-one states have banned abortion, and women across the country are enraged. **And I know that, much like we did in 1992, we can turn our anger into action to elect more Democratic pro-choice women than ever.**

I know we can make 2024 another "Year of the Woman," Peter. I know we can protect the Senate majority by electing and reelecting candidates like **Elissa Slotkin** , **Jacky Rosen** , and **Tammy Baldwin** , and send pro-choice champions like **Yadira Caraveo** , **Mary Peltola** , and **Lauren Underwood** to take back the House — but we need your help. ****So that's why I'm asking, Peter: Will you donate to help hit our $150,000 End-of-Month goal, elect Democratic pro-choice women, and restore abortion access across the country?**

name: Chrissy
subject: Keeping you updated on our policy work
body:
A NOTE FROM CHRISSY

Lately, I’ve been getting asked if the federal government is going to shut down in October. The federal government’s fiscal year runs from October to September and, as is common, there is much disagreement about what programs should be funded and at what levels. What’s less common is that Republicans have a five seat majority and are unable to pass legislation without the support of the most extreme members of their party. And, they are currently unwilling to work with Democrats on a compromise. How does this end if Representative Chip Roy wants to defund entire federal agencies and Senator Tommy Tuberville wants a national abortion ban? We have our work cut out for us when Congress reconvenes after Labor Day.

Defending our LGBTQ Community

You know that when it comes to commonsense compromise, I’m the first to the table. But recently, Republicans, in an unprecedented procedural move, cut nearly $4 million from community support for housing and other resources for LGBTQ Americans. Almost $1 million of that was from Reading, PA in my district. Alongside my team and other members of Congress, I fought back. We haven’t won yet but we persevere.

Improving the Lives of our Veterans

As a third-generation veteran, I’m particularly sensitive about the support we offer to those who have given so much to our country. Veterans shouldn’t struggle alone with issues such as food insecurity or access to health and child care – and that’s why I’ve been pushing the envelope in our House Armed Services Committee’s Quality of Life Panel to offer veterans more.

My 75th Town Hall

It’s hard to believe that I hosted my 75th town hall in July. That’s a lot of town halls! We covered a variety of issues that are top of mind to the community of Coatesville including big improvements to health care services. I was joined by colleagues from the Coatesville VA, Chester County Hospital, and the West Chester Veterans Council to discuss the Penn Medicine partnership with the Coatesville VA Medical Center and other topics.

I’m so grateful you’ve been by my side as I work to serve our community. Trust me: there’s plenty more to do. But, when I have supporters like you by my side, I’m empowered to fight for what is right for every single Pennsylvanian.

There’s more than enough work to be done,

-Chrissy

Chrissy is proud to be your voice in Congress and is committed to fighting for the values that matter in our community. But a divided Congress means there will be challenges ahead. We must all work together to have any chance of creating a better future that work for everyone.

So we're counting on the support of people like you to keep Chrissy's momentum going throughout the year. Can we count on you to join us and donate whatever you can spare right now? THank you for you support and for believing in our vision for a better future.

--------

That's why I've dedicated my life to being a public defender, a federal prosecutor, and a legal liaison to the United States Armed Forces. I believe in the foundational values of America - life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness.

So when Devin Nunes asked me to help with the Russiagate investigation, I told him whatever we discovered about President Trump, _good or bad_ , it had to be published.

It's why I refer to the Russia Gate FBI cabal as government gangsters. They are crooks who abuse their power to extort our elected officials. Their deep connections with the media enable a manufacturing machine of fake news.

Once I found the truth, that's when the spying began...

Since then, I knew I had to do everything to help American patriots by offering financial assistance to whistleblowers, veterans, patriots, and some families of Jan 6 detainees.

As a former federal prosecutor, I know that we need protection if we are going to expose corrupt government gangsters.

Due process has been destroyed.

**We cannot let the justice system be hijacked and used against us. **

[I am humbly asking for your support. Join me in the fight for justice in defending patriots against abuse of the justice system by clicking here >>>](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zev9j0e822gmg9lmh08ro786l920e90thgkt24ug_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9hm8o72cdh2bs)

name: Nikki Haley
subject: I want to share this with you
body:
Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.

| |
---
| | | | [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zrmb2hf62fk9dqhkn5lju3dsu4kv7oda7bq1ean8_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9hm8o72clh2bs)
---

Hi Friend,

If you watched the debate, you know why I'm running for president and the solutions I have to offer to get our country back on track.

But, whether you've been with me from the start or this is the first time you're hearing about me, I couldn't be more grateful to have you on board.

With the first debate kicking this election into high gear, I think it's important to take a few minutes to introduce myself and talk about the journey I have been on. **[Once you've finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z0bpbaumbsls63m1rdsl068r4ihdd3nij37clqco_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9hm8o72clh2bs "Once youââ¬TMve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
| | | | | [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z2rsgt5qmmjlcl5qjlejsemna81fkfgdndpjjn4o_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9hm8o72clh2bs)
---
| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won.**
---
| | [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z1c03tts7pgutjdvj71bcr9g5cb2lqvail8vefo8_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9hm8o72clh2bs)
---
It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

---
| [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zc2qoj8sso4h5ikvki9r7apgos2tgo3r97vjjgng_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9hm8o72clh2bs)
---

I launched my campaign for President over six months ago because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class.

Now, I just completed my **FIRST** debate, and I need a **SURGE** of support to keep the momentum strong in order to continue sharing this message across America! **[It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign post-debate.>>](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zgk9fu9d40d86dbe5kuhqtslktgj1mj07j2jf64g_rp22sh2s8i66p76c9hm8o72clh2bs "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign post-debate.")**

Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will also play a vital role in helping fund our campaign in the upcoming days.

Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today in support of my fight to save America?

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

| | When I first took office, I made the promise to hold an open-to-all town hall in every single one of Oregon's counties every year. With over 1050 town halls and counting, I've kept that promise. This month, I've been back home in Oregon, continuing to fulfill that promise, hosting town halls in every corner of our state. **It's the conversations I have with Oregonians in my town hall meetings that help me stay informed about the priorities and challenges facing our state so that when I head back to Washington, D.C.** I can continue working to propose federal solutions to improve our state. We started off strong this month with town halls on the South Coast. Folks from all walks of life shared their stories and concerns and asked important questions. It's these conversations that keep me grounded and help me do my job. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68801511/424196448/-2044921950?refcode=2023-08-28-august-recap&recurring=&amount=4&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=5f9e4c89-d345-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTQxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZjllNGM4OS1kMzQ1LWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=todQw9dZQ-RyNb98XYsGZx1TWWqf8gmoY84unrH68N0=) Oregon is in the middle of a busy fire season, so I've been getting consistent updates from state and local officials on the ground about these fires and how we can combat them. Not only do these updates help me stay informed about the threat to our communities, but also help me as I work on federal policies to tackle wildfire risk and help increase pay for wildland firefighters. Oregon's agricultural products are some of the most exceptional in the world. From blueberries to wine, beer, cheese, onions and more, there's no shortage of the bounty our state produces. I'm highlighting the ingenuity of our state's hard-working farmers and small businesses producing these world-renowned products. Inclusivity is crucial, and we're always looking for ways to make our democracy more accessible to everyone.
