**SENTENCING OF JOE, HUNTER AND JAMES BIDEN MOVED DUE TO NEWLY DISCLOSED EVIDENCE OF CRIMINALITY**

_Sentencing to Occur Tuesday, September 7, 2023_ _At 12:00 P.M. Eastern | 9:00 A.M. Pacific_ (Boise, Idaho, August 28, 2023)Today, the Citizens’ Prosecutor, Larry Klayman, the General Counsel of Freedom Watch, Inc., announced that the sentencing of Joe, Hunter and James Biden has been moved as a result of newly released evidence.
The criminal indictments and convictions of the Bidens’ concern their accepting of bribes, racketeering and other felonies with regard to a money laundering scheme to enrich Joe Biden and his family carried about by Hunter and James Biden.In addition to this, Joe Biden, as an individual, has been indicted and convicted in relation to his acts of negligent homicide in Afghanistan that resulted in the deaths of 13 American servicemen and Afghan allies including their young children.
Just over the weekend, Ukrainian Prosecutor Viktor Shokin confirmed the Bidens’ criminality on Brian Kilmeade’s ‘One Nation,’ where he claims to have been poisoned twice in attempts to silence him from speaking on the “illegal activities,” including bribery, of Joe, Hunter and James Biden, regarding Burisma.
**This newly released evidence is paramount and will be provided to Judge Michael Pendleton to review and consider in his sentencing of Joe, Hunter and James Biden.**
Larry Klayman, the Citizens Prosecutor, had this to say:
“Given the two tiered, selective prosecution, discriminatory, dishonest and totally corrupt current state of the U. S. Justice Department and its Federal Bureau of Investigation under the despotic ‘leadership’ of Attorney General Merrick Garland and FBI Director Christopher Wray, which under Joe Biden has been weaponized as a virtual ‘Gestapo’ against all those who oppose him, the Democrats and the left, including but hardly limited to the peaceful January 6, 2021 protesters, it was incumbent of the American people themselves, particularly given the lack of courage, if not compromised cowardly Republicans and other government authorities, to hold the ‘Biden Crime Family’ to account under the rule of law.”
**MORE ON THE CITIZENS’ GRAND JURY PROCESS:**
The power and authority of the American people to enforce not just man’s law, but the law of nature and nature’s God, as enumerated in our Declaration of Independence, is sacrosanct. Indeed, a primary reason to declare independence on July 4, 1776, was triggered by King George III and the British monarchy, when they took away from the colonies our criminal justice system, which was sent back to his Court of St. James in London.In the landmark Supreme Court case of Williams vs. United States, 504 U.S. 36 (1992), Justice Antonin Scalia, writing for the majority, ruled that the grand jury and thus the criminal process belongs to the American people and not exclusively to the three branches of government. Thus, this right exists side by side with establishment grand juries administered by the U.S. Justice Department.
**The Bidens’ sentencing will occur and be available to view at**[**www.freedomwatchusa.org**](https://freedomwatchusa.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=72bc9b8de1fa17e6901eb23e7&id=6f19f0a580&e=8edd2b8f7d)**on Zoom and YouTube at 12:00 P.M. Eastern | 9:00 A.M. Pacific Thursday, September 7, 2023.**
**THE CONVICTION RULING OF THE CITIZENS JUDGE CAN BE FOUND AT**[**WWW.FREEDOMWATCHUSA.ORG**](https://freedomwatchusa.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=72bc9b8de1fa17e6901eb23e7&id=2c93a1648b&e=8edd2b8f7d)**.********You may also contact Asher Anderson at**[**asher.andersonfw@gmail.com**](mailto:asher.andersonfw@gmail.com)**for more information.******

| Peter, This is Scott Baugh here – in case we haven’t met yet, I’m the Republican who came within 3 percentage points of dethroning left-wing Progressive Caucus Leader Katie Porter last cycle... even in spite of her raising more than _$29 million_ for her campaign warchest.

Now, Porter is throwing her hat in California’s Senate race, and guess what that means for this critical Orange County Congressional seat?

**That’s right – it’s going to be wide open. Republicans have a golden opportunity before us to FLIP CA-47 and finally restore thoughtful conservative representation to the O.C. Get this – __the Chair of the NRCC is even calling this district the TOP TARGET for Republicans in the entire country!__**
---

| Make no mistake, though – _this is also going to be one of the most expensive and competitive Congressional elections in the country,_ too. Democrat Party leaders aren’t going to let us gain ground in California without putting up a fight!

**But I’m ready for the challenge, Peter****,** and I’ll tell you why, right before asking you to join me in this important mission (don’t worry – no donation required).

First though, let me quickly introduce myself:

I grew up on a farm and learned from an early age the value of hard work and the importance of Faith, Family, and Freedom.

Now, I’m a local business owner with a passion for serving my community.

I served Orange County in the State Assembly, standing up for conservative values in the face of California’s far-left politicians. I’ve chaired both the Orange County Republican Party and Orange County’s Gang Reduction Program, where we provide kids a chance to succeed in life while preventing violent crime on our streets.

This has been my home for over 33 years – I love the O.C., I love my neighbors, and I love the life we are able to live in this special place. That’s why I do my best to give back everywhere I can.

**But here’s the truth – under far-left leadership from the likes of Katie Porter, our representatives have been taking us in the wrong direction. **

Their “solution” to every problem is more taxes and more spending even when Americans struggle to afford gas, food, and basic necessities.

They’ve gone along with the far-left immigration policies of the Biden Administration that have left our Southern Border exposed.

And they’ve refused to take action on the rising crime in California that’s leaving our neighborhoods unsafe.

**This election is our chance to finally get things turned around. We must restore thoughtful conservative leadership to CA-47, make O.C. Red Again, and deliver policies that serve the interests of folks in Orange County... NOT some left-wing Democrat agenda.**

I’m ready for the mission ahead, Peter – we have the momentum and already proved we can compete with the powerful California Democrat Machine.

_The only thing we need now is a strong sign that folks like you are with me..._

**So will you help me make that loud and clear by joining my fight to flip CA-47? No donation required – just a quick click to join our team and help us lay the groundwork for this must-win election!**

We kick things off by discussing the possibility of returning to COVID restrictions. Krysty fears even though many of us won’t want to comply it could get ugly pushing back. The conversation takes a fascinating turn as Mark breaks down how the “experts” failure on the first COVID go-around has destroyed trust now.

Mark and Krysty dive into the arts colliding with the spiritual scene with a focus on the Walker Art Center's demon-themed art event.
It's an alarming discussion that highlights the spiritual struggle for our nation's soul and the importance of standing up against those who are trying to make Satanism mainstream.

body:
I’m running to be Florida’s next U.S. Senator — and I hope you’ll give me a moment to share why.

| Peter, I’m running to be Florida’s next U.S. Senator — and I hope you’ll give me a moment to share why.
---
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/68803199/424202164/-225452087?refcode=BLU-FFP-20230828-1-EM&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjgwOTAxNzE2LWQ4NDUtZWUxMS1hM2YxLTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=62PewuIAh2S93EETD8PxxhORJxBT9fZeH3iZffx2uxU=) _My husband and three children._
I was born in Ecuador, and when I was 14, my mother brought my sisters and me to America in search of a better life.

We made a new home in a small, one room apartment in America. My mother worked double shifts as a home health care provider and at night, she took classes to learn English. When I was 15, I started picking up shifts at the local doughnut shop to help us make ends meet.

My mother’s hard work, incredible sacrifices, and relentlessly fierce hope made it possible for me to graduate college and become the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress. **She taught me that a better education, a better home, and a better future is always possible if we never give up. This is the promise of America.**

_**And that’s why I’m running for Senate. Because Florida deserves better, and we’ve got to fight for it.**_

Right now, our state is being pushed backward by far-right extremists like my opponent, Sen. Rick Scott. He’s targeting the most vulnerable amongst us, dividing our communities, and threatening the American dream. It’s no wonder why a mere 40% of Floridians view him favorably.

With experts saying Rick Scott is one of the most vulnerable senators up for reelection in 2024, I know that we can defeat him and restore the promise of America — but not without all hands on deck.

[_**So please, will you join the fight for a better future by splitting a donation of $25 between Fight for Progress and my campaign? If we win in Florida, Democrats are virtually guaranteed to defend our Senate majority.**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/68803201/424202166/-225452087?refcode=BLU-FFP-20230828-1-EM&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjgwOTAxNzE2LWQ4NDUtZWUxMS1hM2YxLTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=62PewuIAh2S93EETD8PxxhORJxBT9fZeH3iZffx2uxU=)

clean_body: I’m running to be Florida’s next U.S. Senator — and I hope you’ll give me a moment to share why. | Peter, I’m running to be Florida’s next U.S. Senator — and I hope you’ll give me a moment to share why. = My husband and three children. I was born in Ecuador, and when I was 14, my mother brought my sisters and me to America in search of a better life. We made a new home in a small, one room apartment in America. My mother worked double shifts as a home health care provider and at night, she took classes to learn English. When I was 15, I started picking up shifts at the local doughnut shop to help us make ends meet. My mother’s hard work, incredible sacrifices, and relentlessly fierce hope made it possible for me to graduate college and become the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress. She taught me that a better education, a better home, and a better future is always possible if we never give up. This is the promise of America. And that’s why I’m running for Senate. Because Florida deserves better, and we’ve got to fight for it. Right now, our state is being pushed backward by far-right extremists like my opponent, Sen. Rick Scott. He’s targeting the most vulnerable amongst us, dividing our communities, and threatening the American dream. It’s no wonder why a mere 40% of Floridians view him favorably. With experts saying Rick Scott is one of the most vulnerable senators up for reelection in 2024, I know that we can defeat him and restore the promise of America — but not without all hands on deck. = | = | = | = | = | = Thank you for joining me in this fight. The sad fact is that this could happen to any of us at any time.| | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68803408/424202862/1649708063?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS8xMDAwNjciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTkxYWFiMmEtZDk0NS1lZTExLWEzZjEtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=3YyXi7dDTadbL8wbjUsd6jN35A-GOtC-h-jJ5Y9CItI=)
---
Friend, On Sunday night, I got the text from my sister nobody ever wants to get, "Seeing movie at Easton AMC. Was evacuated, shootings occurred. We ran away from the area, along with many, many people. Waiting it out, so we can get the car and go home." My heart sank! I was absolutely terrified! While I waited anxiously for more information, my mind raced about what could be happening, whether my sister and brother in-law and those around them were safe. Easton is right outside of my district, in Columbus, just 20 minutes from me. Like most incidences of gun violence, this happened at a time and place where no one would expect it as Easton is an upscale shopping center.
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68803409/424202863/1649708063?refcode=gunviolence-8-28NGP_picture&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS8xMDAwNjciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTkxYWFiMmEtZDk0NS1lZTExLWEzZjEtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=3YyXi7dDTadbL8wbjUsd6jN35A-GOtC-h-jJ5Y9CItI=)
---
The shooters were 13 years old, 13! This is what our country has come to, especially with the rise in hate speech and fearmongering. Leadership starts at the top, and we must do better. Just one day before the shooting in Easton, news broke that a racist murderer who initially targeted Black students at a nearby school, was thwarted by security, so he changed course to kill Black people at a Dollar General in Jacksonville, Florida, killing three. My heart breaks for the victims and their families. **But what is no longer news is that mass shootings and horrific acts of gun violence are happening across America at an unprecedented and alarming frequency.** The shooting in Easton is also especially scary for me and members of my family, as we are approaching the 23 year anniversary of my aunt being shot and killed by her husband in the parking lot of the elementary school where she worked. The shootings over the weekend, and the evacuation at the theater where my sister was casually going to take in a movie, are a stark reminder of the terrible trauma that lingers from gun violence, so much of it preventable. One of the reasons that I am in this race against Jim Jordan is because not only do the people of my district, and the entire state, suffer from his complete lack of leadership and unwillingness to get anything done in Congress—**Jordan is a huge part of the problem.** He peddles dangerous conspiracy theories around guns and fights commonsense gun legislation, all while using the issue of gun violence to manipulate the voters and keep us divided. Jim Jordan and the rest of the fearmongering GOP would rather keep profiting politically and materially from dark money groups like the NRA than work in a bipartisan fashion to keep our children safe. They would rather we accept the status quo as a fact of life, as if we have always lived like this and we always will, this is wrong and despicable. **We have to call them out and continue to fight as hard as we can for our freedoms—the freedom to live in peace and to be safe, without the fear of being gunned down for who we are or what we believe.** We’ll never be free or safe with gun lobby tools like Jim Jordan in power. **[From my family to yours, I am asking for your support for my campaign to take him down. Will you join the fight by donating $25 to help me defeat Jim Jordan, so I can fight for smart, bipartisan, commonsense gun legislation in Congress?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68803410/424202864/1649708063?refcode=gunviolence-8-28NGP&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS8xMDAwNjciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTkxYWFiMmEtZDk0NS1lZTExLWEzZjEtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=3YyXi7dDTadbL8wbjUsd6jN35A-GOtC-h-jJ5Y9CItI=)**

_**But together, we won.**_

When I was nominated for Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. _Then I went to work._ I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

But, saving our country will require us to elect a candidate who not only can defeat Biden and Harris, but one who can lead our country into a brighter future.

When I look to the future, I see America strong once more.

We'll end inflation and build an economy that works for all, just like we did in South Carolina.

In the America I see, every child gets a world-class education - because every parent gets to pick their child's school.

In the America I see, police know we have their backs - criminals know we have their number - and our streets will be safe again!

In the America I see, we stop the surge of drugs and illegal immigration. That means having a real border and mandatory e-verify, like we got done in South Carolina.

In the America I see, everyone has full confidence in our elections. Voter ID will be the law of the land - like I did as governor of South Carolina!

The America I see is freer and better for all.

We'll end corporate welfare and bailouts for big business - and we'll end the earmarks and pork-barrel spending that fuel big government.

And when it comes to our politicians, we'll light a fire under them...Their job is not to say things on TV. Their job is to do things in DC - like solve problems instead of ignoring or creating them!

In the America I see, the permanent politician will finally retire...

We'll have term limits for Congress and we'll have mental competency tests for politicians over the age of 75!

Most of all, I see a strong America because I see a proud America.

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

Hi, friends -- I wanted to make sure you saw a big update on our race: **On Wednesday, my good friend Congressman Jamie Raskin endorsed our campaign for Senate!**
I’m so proud to have Jamie’s support, and I hope you take a moment to read his personal note below. He knows it’s going to take a strategic, thoughtful operation to win this race.
[**So, in honor of this special endorsement, will you make a contribution to my campaign today? With just three days left until our August end-of-month benchmark, your support is extremely helpful.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-august23.skpj0d&refcode=em230828-1-30&t=1&akid=648%2E135344%2EaGK4vu)**
**[CONTRIBUTE](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-august23.skpj0d&refcode=em230828-1-30&t=2&akid=648%2E135344%2EaGK4vu)**
Thank you so much, and keep scrolling to read Jamie’s message!
\- Elissa
_\---------- Begin forwarded message ---------
From: Jamie Raskin
Subject: I’m in Michigan to endorse my friend Elissa for U.S. Senate
To: dpwillis67@gmail.com _ [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-august23.skpj0d&refcode=em230828-1-30&t=3&akid=648%2E135344%2EaGK4vu)

Hi there -- it’s Congressman Jamie Raskin, the Representative for Maryland’s 8th Congressional District.
**Today, I am in Ann Arbor to announce my endorsement of my friend Elissa Slotkin to represent Michigan in the U.S. Senate.** I have gotten to know Elissa by working alongside her in the House, and I have seen her fight tooth-and-nail for the issues that really matter to people -- access to affordable health care, gun safety, fighting on behalf of workers and so much more -- I know there is no one better to represent Michiganders in the U.S. Senate.
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-august23.skpj0d&refcode=em230828-1-30&t=4&akid=648%2E135344%2EaGK4vu)
And all eyes are going to be on Michigan next November – this open seat in a notorious swing state could very well determine whether or not Democrats’ maintain control of the Senate. But Elissa Slotkin knows a thing or two about tough races -- she ran in and won a Republican leaning district -- not once, but three times. She’s exactly the type of candidate who can keep Michigan blue and protect our Democratic Senate majority.

Friends, I’ll keep this short, but it has to be said:
The Supreme Court has lost the faith of the American people.
From the absolutely gutting Dobbs decision that we’ve spent a year grappling with to the slate of deeply disturbing decisions this summer, I know a lot of folks are reeling and scared for what all this means for our future.
We need significant, structural reform to restore the legitimacy of the Court, and to restore faith in our democracy.
Add your name to my petition now if you agree that it’s time to reform the Supreme Court. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/m397MmKOqUWO-3OskXB7ig2]
In a country that thrives on checks and balances, it’s important to say that our lack of faith in the Court doesn’t come from disagreeing with their decisions (though that’s certainly a horrific byproduct) - it’s that the Court itself is steeped in corruption and ethics violations .
From Clarence Thomas to Brett Kavanaugh, there are too many questions left unanswered - about who funds their vacations, who sends them gifts, who pays off their debts, and more - and no one but Congress is willing to hold them accountable. Our Court is supposed to be free from undue political influence, but it’s painfully clear that’s no longer the case.
If you agree that it’s time to take action on this, please sign my petition today demanding a serious look at judicial reform. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/m397MmKOqUWO-3OskXB7ig2]
Thanks for your support.
-Sara

I'm a proud daughter of legal immigrants, a wife of a combat veteran, and a mother of two. I have watched the American Dream unfold before me.

_**But, with the Democrats in power, our future is slipping. **_

Right now, we have too many families paying too much for groceries; too many small businesses who can't afford rent, and too many big businesses getting taxpayer bailouts.

We have too much crime on our streets - too many drugs flooding our cities - and too few police and border patrol.

And from Joe Biden on down, our leaders put too much trust in big government and too little trust in the American people.

They have us spiraling toward socialism, with a new trillion-dollar spending bill every few months, and _a national debt over 32 trillion dollars._

_**This is not the America I want to leave to my children! **_

I am running for president to save our country from the downward spiral of socialism and defeatism. I aim to move America upward toward freedom and strength.

_**[But, I need your help to make it happen. Can I count on you?](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=d0dd5f8edf7d4154aa1f921592157032&_e=0_2wY8E4z5EthbNM0acoiSQZVoCclWgsKVFUucZGljdFlFG6EuPkO-Pwdgn_GO_Xq6b5gOWdDl8qTmNVmtSOK5KN96_RR1GHzfeiPcIeuOKjzTuTefvKcoBNOycxdqS1pmQBB-MgU444ucwwXamZ76c8NbZqiolve-iJESSIc3DcU5Xwd0-37ZwmtXvvmeN6U9gc5umK_1-44QC05YMd8WeCJa7QnfLd6xjLgNTi5O06cGnQSx3rcJq1MQz1R7dY6JxUnNwnAkkBXoX4-c8IZjHjCmmgSsNfY_Co4YDuggQmuV9s-ovi24Ha1AXgd8BKKZgbqex91OBRS06S4Nt0CI6Wr9CwlsjoliIkwTe6Xio%3D "But, I need your help to make it happen. Can I count on you? ")**_

I can promise you, America is always worth fighting for.

As a brown girl, growing up in a black-and-white world, I saw the promise of America unfold before me.

As the proud wife of a combat veteran, I saw our people's deep love of freedom, and determination to defend it.

As Governor, I saw our state move beyond hate and violence, and lift everyone in peace.

And as Ambassador, I saw that America is still the standard.

Our moment is now - and our mission is clear.

Over the last six months we've held more than 100 campaign events across the country, met with thousands of voters, and drawn a line in the sand on important policy issues. Now, I just completed my FIRST debate, and we're continuing to build a SURGE of momentum. BUT , we still have a lot of ground to cover in order to win the White House and save our country! "As we continue to build a winning campaign, I want to remind you why I am running for president and why your support matters." | I'm a proud daughter of legal immigrants, a wife of a combat veteran, and a mother of two. I have watched the American Dream unfold before me. But, with the Democrats in power, our future is slipping. Right now, we have too many families paying too much for groceries; too many small businesses who can't afford rent, and too many big businesses getting taxpayer bailouts. We have too much crime on our streets - too many drugs flooding our cities - and too few police and border patrol. And from Joe Biden on down, our leaders put too much trust in big government and too little trust in the American people. They have us spiraling toward socialism, with a new trillion-dollar spending bill every few months, and a national debt over 32 trillion dollars. This is not the America I want to leave to my children! I am running for president to save our country from the downward spiral of socialism and defeatism. I aim to move America upward toward freedom and strength. "But, I need your help to make it happen. Can I count on you? " I can promise you, America is always worth fighting for. As a brown girl, growing up in a black-and-white world, I saw the promise of America unfold before me. As the proud wife of a combat veteran, I saw our people's deep love of freedom, and determination to defend it. As Governor, I saw our state move beyond hate and violence, and lift everyone in peace. And as Ambassador, I saw that America is still the standard. Our moment is now - and our mission is clear. "Will you help me save our country and secure our future?" | | "I appreciate your support more than you can imagine. If you can join me today by chipping in, it would mean so much to me." Thank you for everything you do for our country. My very best, Nikki R. ---

---
Fellow Conservative, The first Republican primary debate was an opportunity for the nation to hear directly from their future President. To earn YOUR support, I stood up, weathered the attacks, and now I know that we are one step closer to stopping the decline of this country. **If you 're just tuning into the race after this pivotal debate, I'd like to take a moment to tell you a little bit about myself so you know why I'm running for President, what I plan to accomplish, and why I'm asking for your support.** _**Here 's my story**_: I was a blue-collar kid born and raised in Florida who went on to work my way through Yale University where I was Team Captain of our baseball team, before going on to graduate from Harvard Law School. After earning my degrees and witnessing the horrific attack on our nation's freedom on September 11th, 2001, I knew I had to stand up. I volunteered for the Navy and went on to serve in Iraq as a JAG Officer in support of SEAL Team 1.
---
| [](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=a78e398633a84665985c6e888f451264&_e=8kNirLMyGmO1Gz0qGhb7PwFGH4qU-uBFu1DN5kazeTz8V6MgFB-Nk-520RPX0YGDfie8Jkigj5ikGvIofABbi-K57y74y2qw74Dv0ZHeGlQRH0lNqBUE6akOtRbVT5vXhXvqBEeAD8AkVCqJk7i4BX4dQAbCx81X_W4YKeDeK7L161KvtaxwZLqvIhlAe7TpqmxyXcunSs3ZJrJgz2-nkv4pydAZOrQbgokH0MvceZ5aEY4l4asM9CG7FvwIht1sj7-ArqTGqZRMX7frf03SDVGNMJkI4BLlD5v_KrUb8SnJSFE5mmazB3XrdEuHLQuGHp6-fJ08lGc2HkOQymCDAe6sN3uzfN-QjWlcvWjgzwi5ZOUIBQ7BLk9JqIZ5mnHOXgAaKyWP912WR_w4K1yNVyjxSCwB0fy1XYyKSyU6TcM%3D)
---
Since my time serving in the Navy, I have taken on the role of prosecutor, Congressman, proud Governor of the free state of Florida, father to three young children, and husband to my wonderful wife, Casey.
---
| [](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=a78e398633a84665985c6e888f451264&_e=8kNirLMyGmO1Gz0qGhb7PwFGH4qU-uBFu1DN5kazeTz8V6MgFB-Nk-520RPX0YGDfie8Jkigj5ikGvIofABbi-K57y74y2qw74Dv0ZHeGlQRH0lNqBUE6akOtRbVT5vXhXvqBEeAD8AkVCqJk7i4BX4dQAbCx81X_W4YKeDeK7L161KvtaxwZLqvIhlAe7TpqmxyXcunSs3ZJrJgz2-nkv4pydAZOrQbgokH0MvceZ5aEY4l4asM9CG7FvwIht1sucvcuh2FRDUxXaH_VirqVCAp6e-_ki3q1lkWv7sS-WpMoZwYAHTnq6-INloFhZGkWb3h91JhwYiCn4KIbMvD5loWFV8uJtBrZDQdjFzhHsDm2I1R8FhkXx-7eUOzeMxExfF8wXaQjhrxpDbahs8_cvDY3s_h3YCCbZ6HKcJKFus%3D)
---

As Governor, I have made it my mission to lead with conviction, unwavering energy, and with a refusal to back down. That's why, in Florida, we held the line when freedom hung in the balance. When Covid policies across the country made commonsense an uncommon virtue, our state became a refuge of sanity and a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans. Leadership matters and I believe my record speaks for itself. Since I took office as Governor, Florida now:
* Ranks as the number one economy in the country by CNBC;
* Ranks number one for new business formations;

* Ranks number one for net in-migration;
* Ranks number one for economic growth amongst large states;
* Has an unemployment rate that is a percentage point below the national average and even lower than other large states like California and New York;
* Ranks number one in education by US News and World Report;
* Has NO state income tax;

* Has a crime rate at a 50-year low.

I have worked tirelessly to transform a once purple state to a deep red blueprint for freedom.
---
| [](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=a78e398633a84665985c6e888f451264&_e=8kNirLMyGmO1Gz0qGhb7PwFGH4qU-uBFu1DN5kazeTz8V6MgFB-Nk-520RPX0YGDfie8Jkigj5ikGvIofABbi-K57y74y2qw74Dv0ZHeGlQRH0lNqBUE6akOtRbVT5vXhXvqBEeAD8AkVCqJk7i4BX4dQAbCx81X_W4YKeDeK7L161KvtaxwZLqvIhlAe7TpqmxyXcunSs3ZJrJgz2-nkv4pydAZOrQbgokH0MvceZ5aEY4l4asM9CG7FvwIht1subFiCrU3h9LSd90xjZpQ2WGKzDlovKXVf4oaSExOL2nzx044KHCcXG8nw9BWFtPY0Q-wtsKpQb6Yl9s4coZ-0A9zYRPmGaK_vxG9w6Si4fNVZ7Aq7NW7HbgUvxVGG9uFICN6l4wJsKbVsRPyQTsHExxwDdW47qhyUH04WSx9vlA%3D)
---
But here's the problem, Fellow Conservative. Failing leftist policies across the country are shoving a radical ideology down your throat. They're telling you that men can get pregnant, want to impose a social credit score on you, and let Mexican drug cartels cross our border freely and continue to murder Americans. This is NOT okay. Riots and disorder have infested some of this nation's oldest cities and turned places like Chicago, Philadelphia, and San Francisco into crime slums. I am NOT willing to accept this decline. We have a President who is floundering and bowing down to his own party instead of doing what is right for the American people. He has consistently bent the knee to the woke mob. These radical policies across the nation are making it nearly impossible for hardworking families to achieve the American Dream, and as a father of three young children and husband to my wife Casey, I cannot sit idly by while their future hangs in the balance. _**This election is not about me. It 's about YOU and the American children who are being subjected to the woke mob's fraud.**_
---
| [](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=a78e398633a84665985c6e888f451264&_e=8kNirLMyGmO1Gz0qGhb7PwFGH4qU-uBFu1DN5kazeTz8V6MgFB-Nk-520RPX0YGDfie8Jkigj5ikGvIofABbi-K57y74y2qw74Dv0ZHeGlQRH0lNqBUE6akOtRbVT5vXhXvqBEeAD8AkVCqJk7i4BX4dQAbCx81X_W4YKeDeK7L161KvtaxwZLqvIhlAe7TpqmxyXcunSs3ZJrJgz2-nkv4pydAZOrQbgokH0MvceZ5aEY4l4asM9CG7FvwIht1sERM2q5OJSZPbkwkrQKH1XH7LPU43vDmZxH-LjtbXqNz35HM2noRmWMtio82owAHExOcgim3u8utJgahFFRnaY2NHSs3IIDAaTJm3gtGIxgJr0O3tpch1a29xgdpXhru6h4ZHXnxoqmBJ-wC-aM6ChG2nn5aKEeWo6BLKEeu84OQ%3D)
---
Our nation is facing a critical choice in 2024: Freedom or Decline. That is why I am running for President; I will not stand by while Joe Biden sends this nation into deeper decline for another four years. I'm not running to be President. I am running to DO things as President and from Day One we are going to rip up disastrous policies that are harming American families and REVERSE the decline Joe Biden has let fester in this country. The time to act is NOW.
---
| [](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=a78e398633a84665985c6e888f451264&_e=8kNirLMyGmO1Gz0qGhb7PwFGH4qU-uBFu1DN5kazeTz8V6MgFB-Nk-520RPX0YGDfie8Jkigj5ikGvIofABbi-K57y74y2qw74Dv0ZHeGlQRH0lNqBUE6akOtRbVT5vXhXvqBEeAD8AkVCqJk7i4BX4dQAbCx81X_W4YKeDeK7L161KvtaxwZLqvIhlAe7TpqmxyXcunSs3ZJrJgz2-nkv4pydAZOrQbgokH0MvceZ5aEY4l4asM9CG7FvwIht1sUBpGAZyMeFhODiQJ-xJDRLLDfbwjVB9yku-WuFX5Ob4wRHwTZknREVm6JnXKio6L-SZE5E9Y4XDot6AQVmqLbfaaSewvVCj1fKCGAboLuUddJc6G18vnX90Z4xqOYb72FPioGOsZzzv0CCjfBUdotNyosLuVpFJ9ow_4bnUzds0%3D)

| | [Chip in to my campaign here](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=a78e398633a84665985c6e888f451264&_e=8kNirLMyGmO1Gz0qGhb7PwFGH4qU-uBFu1DN5kazeTz8V6MgFB-Nk-520RPX0YGDfie8Jkigj5ikGvIofABbi-K57y74y2qw74Dv0ZHeGlQRH0lNqBUE6akOtRbVT5vXhXvqBEeAD8AkVCqJk7i4BX4dQAbCx81X_W4YKeDeK7L161KvtaxwZLqvIhlAe7TpqmxyXcunSs3ZJrJgz2-nkv4pydAZOrQbgokH0MvceZ5aEY4l4asM9CG7FvwIht1sn8WW3_PFIBefIMFgHYHSAxxbZQklx4qa75UZs-x-VACSf2k_698DECQJMpDeKj-X19dCgEYWNK0MXj-5BPVm031kODqm_eG8fUMR2cZBuMzZd5rtOT0zAsXdouax3ZUqIjU5Dmvwp6zbKH0a_bvUsYhpNMqCHXBiPh9ds36Nrnw%3D)

I believe that decline is choice, success is attainable, and freedom is worth fighting for. I fought with everything I had on that debate stage on August 23rd and took my vision for restoring this nation directly to the American people. I know that no one is entitled to anything in this world, so I am fighting to earn your support and lead when it matters most. | Peter,

I know many believe politicians are only in office to fill their pockets, serving themselves while forgetting about the people who elected them. I ran to rid Washington of this perception of corruption, and to bring a voice of reason and fairness to Congress. _**My mission is to deliver results for the people of Virginia.**_

I spend much of my time writing, cosponsoring, and advocating for legislation that will better the lives of Virginians. Whether it be allowing families to sit together on planes without additional fees or advocating for women’s reproductive rights, I remain focused on improving life for the people I represent.

_**But, sometimes, I am called not just to deliver results, but to better the system itself.**_ All elected officials should serve their constituents first and foremost, not be working to line their pockets. ---|---|---
In February 2022, SpaceX launched 49 Starlink satellites from a Falcon 9 rocket into low-earth orbit. A day after being deployed, the [company reported that a geomagnetic storm disrupted the trajectories of 40 of their satellites](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/6e597bea-3c16-4494-a4fa-005ccff7b2af?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), causing them to burn up upon reentry to the planet. While the impact to date on satellites has been limited, it's important to understand that solar storms happen with some regularity, due to the [sun's 11-year solar cycle](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/405f60a7-3c69-492f-9c4b-8f0ccf06d374?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Every cycle, [the star's magnetic field flips (meaning the north and south poles switch places), generating a period of increasing and decreasing solar activity (visible via sunspots)](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/87469c7b-c82b-4c85-95cd-7f7a313e4fec?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Giant eruptions on the sun such as [solar flares](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/06200903-9786-41df-8191-9ad5242f78cb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [coronal mass ejections (CMEs)](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/e12f1b7a-9f1d-4ad6-9d66-53da8a78af47?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) send massive amounts of solar material and radiation into space. Because these ejections head out in all directions from the sun, most miss Earth. But every now and then, a tidal wave of charged particles does strike our planet and temporarily disturbs the Earth's magnetic fields. When this occurs, [aurora lights](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/da69e5cc-a3b0-4377-9d81-94dc0fb06de9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that are normally only visible near the poles can be seen closer to the equator (see video below):
[](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/32abe05e-6978-414d-bf9e-7b3366bd4901?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Fortunately, most solar storms do not directly affect humans, but the magnetic disturbances can change the density of the atmosphere in which satellites are moving (as was the case in 2022 with the Starlink satellites) or far more importantly, [they can create magnetic activity that induces potentially problematic electric currents](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/fb5eaf08-0c91-4eae-a580-8edc1d5b9001?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
On **March 10, 1989** [astronomers observed a massive eruption on the sun that sent a billion-ton cloud of gas (with the energy equivalent of thousands of nuclear bombs simultaneously exploding) toward Earth at a million miles per hour](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/99f3fbcf-6576-4e21-ab2f-e59c83d5da32?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The geomagnetic storm it created on Earth was noticeable on March 12th when _aurora borealis_ (the "northern lights") could be seen in Florida and Cuba, visible evidence of an extremely powerful solar storm. When the disruption finally "made landfall" during the early morning of March 13, 1989, more than 200 American power grid problems emerged and the entire grid in Quebec Canada failed.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..ZbK11j2mT0wdmpsVNvjhk7yDWrILgoxOlRPBfBR1Cqo?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=136462025)
The event, known as the Quebec Blackout, was by no means the most powerful solar storm to hit Earth. That distinction continues to be held (as of August 28, 2023) by the **Carrington Event of 1859**. On September 1st of that year, amateur skywatcher [Richard Carrington was sketching sunspots when he observed a "white light flare" that lasted about five minutes](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/983ade79-b45a-474e-938b-eaa91472059e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The coronal mass ejection that Carrington had seen was massive and [took a mere 17.6 hours to reach Earth](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/983ade79-b45a-474e-938b-eaa91472059e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) rather than the days it took during the Quebec Blackout. [It's believed the burst contained as much energy as a billion atomic bombs](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/a9b1e011-651f-477f-ad8d-611cfc358954?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The massive geomagnetic storm led to auroral displays in the tropics and wreaked havoc on the then-prevailing communications technology, the telegraph. According to History.com,
> _**[E.W. Culgan, a telegraph manager in Pittsburgh, reported that the resulting currents flowing through the wires were so powerful that platinum contacts were in danger of melting and"streams of fire" were pouring forth from the circuits. In Washington, D.C., telegraph operator Frederick W. Royce was severely shocked as his forehead grazed a ground wire. According to a witness, an arc of fire jumped from Royce's head to the telegraphic equipment. Some telegraph stations that used chemicals to mark sheets reported that powerful surges caused telegraph paper to combust.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/a9b1e011-651f-477f-ad8d-611cfc358954?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_
While the breakdown of communications and power systems can indeed be concerning, **[a massive solar storm in 1967](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/332eb241-6f2c-49b2-9139-52b8ec6464e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ came close to spurring a global nuclear war between the United States and the USSR](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/332eb241-6f2c-49b2-9139-52b8ec6464e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). [In May of that year, a geomagnetic storm disrupted the radars of America's Ballistic Missile Early Warning System](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/959882cc-44be-42c5-867a-d5c58231cec4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). It appeared to many military leaders as Soviet radar jamming these radar immediately prior to a nuclear attack on the United States. [Commanders put US forces in a "ready to launch" status](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/959882cc-44be-42c5-867a-d5c58231cec4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), but because of the Air Force's emerging interest in solar storms and space weather, solar forecasters at NORAD were able to convince military commanders that the radar attacks came from the sun. Yes, it's true, space weathermen prevented nuclear war!
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..ZbK11j2mT0wdmpsVNvjhk7yDWrILgoxOlRPBfBR1Cqo?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=136462025)
Unfortunately, the devastating impacts of powerful solar storms have been replicated by humans here on Earth. "[High-altitude nuclear detonations, specialized conventional munitions, or non-nuclear directed energy devices](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/c3072acc-f6be-4122-a961-95673d1acf46?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" can be used to create similar, or even more powerful, effects. By intentionally creating and directing the power of a geomagnetic storm, these electromagnetic pulse [(EMP) attacks can bring down targeted electricity grids and other critical infrastructure](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/09473bde-52dd-41c1-8aca-ff7039d5008a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The effects could cripple the United States (or any other country for that matter), something made crystal clear by William Forstchen's novel [One Second After](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/cb32933a-6b31-4644-9e5b-015c13f05c5b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (a book I highly recommend!). In fact, James Woolsey, former director of the US Central Intelligence Agency, testified in 2015 to the US Senate Committee on Homeland Security and Government Affairs on the potential impact of an EMP attack on America:
> _**[...There are essentially two estimates on how many people would die from hunger, from starvation, from lack of water, and from social disruption. One estimate is that within a year or so, two-thirds of the United States population would die. The other estimate is that within a year or so, 90% of the U.S. population would die. We're talking about total devastation. We're not talking about just a regular catastrophe.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b62191d3-3313-4464-8f50-b5549d107f88?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_
In 2017, in the midst of tension-escalating regular rocket launches, North Korea state media noted that it possessed a "[multifunctional thermonuclear nuke with great destructive power which can be detonated at high altitudes for super-powerful EMP according to strategic goals](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b595c90e-8b7e-4107-b49b-d792686061ba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)."
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/ab89c29a-9c98-41f2-afb3-ad06542192a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Source: [https://www.wsj.com/articles/electromagnetic-pulse-north-koreas-latest-threat-against-u-s-1504435000](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/58756355-9c61-4eaf-aed2-ce8fae1c9f2d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Given our ever increasing reliance on technology and electricity, a Carrington Event or EMP attack on the United States would likely create chaos as power disappeared for weeks, months, or possibly even years. Forstchen's book provides a powerful scenario of what might transpire "one second after" an EMP attack. I won't ruin it or you, but imagine a world in which refrigeration wasn't available, cars didn't run, and basic societal safety nets broke down...for months and months.
There is also a forthcoming documentary called "[Grid Down, Power Up](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/8e36b8f1-abcd-4fbf-bb95-db0565fc8520?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" produced by my friend David Tice and narrated by Dennis Quaid that does a superb job of highlighting our dependence on the grid and its many vulnerabilities. I recently watched it and can say without question that it should be required for all government officials, policymakers, business leaders, and students to watch.
[](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/0310ddfc-a86e-4f1a-9776-1257ddc96f5a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Preventing asymmetric threats from solar storms and EMP attacks is almost impossible to do. For one, we don't fully understand the dynamics within the sun and are still not able to predict when solar eruptions are going to happen, how large they may be, and in which direction they will point. Artificial intelligence and quantum computing promise to increase our understanding, but advancements are far from certain and the timing unknown. It's also notoriously hard to predict when a country like North Korea is going to launch a missile and its likely objective. Intelligence efforts can assist, but they rarely provide certainty. But in both cases, early warning systems can help us have a jump on preparing before the likely strikes. Space weather monitoring will continuously improve over time, and missile defense systems offer some promise in protecting critical infrastructure from EMP attacks.
While we should definitely try to prevent or least learn rapidly about inbound solar storms or EMP attacks, it's also critical that we also focus on resilience and the ability to withstand magnetic disruptions. We've hardened much of our critical infrastructure against electricity surges from lightning strikes, why not do so from geomagnetic and electromagnetic pulses? In the grand scheme of matters, the additional cost is an insurance premium worth paying.
Finally, we should develop plans for how we can coordinate monitoring, warning, resilience, and response efforts across the United States government. In this regard, the United States' [National Space Weather Strategy and Action Plan](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/0a419627-477a-49c0-a6b1-e56b9143d499?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and the [Executive Order on Coordinating National Resilience to Electromagnetic Pulses](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b7f24075-75ed-4b09-8261-9ff7e7cbe7de?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) are steps in the right direction. But we need to do a lot more. We must raise awareness of the risks and the many solutions that are available today. As "[Grid Down, Power Up](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/66796b60-23c7-4d73-99e9-424b9977917e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" makes clear, what's ultimately at risk is our way of life, and surely that's something everyone believes we should protect.

A day after being deployed, the , causing them to burn up upon reentry to the planet. While the impact to date on satellites has been limited, it's important to understand that solar storms happen with some regularity, due to the . Every cycle, . Giant eruptions on the sun such as and send massive amounts of solar material and radiation into space. Because these ejections head out in all directions from the sun, most miss Earth. But every now and then, a tidal wave of charged particles does strike our planet and temporarily disturbs the Earth's magnetic fields. When this occurs, that are normally only visible near the poles can be seen closer to the equator (see video below): Fortunately, most solar storms do not directly affect humans, but the magnetic disturbances can change the density of the atmosphere in which satellites are moving (as was the case in 2022 with the Starlink satellites) or far more importantly, . On March 10, 1989 . The geomagnetic storm it created on Earth was noticeable on March 12th when aurora borealis (the "northern lights") could be seen in Florida and Cuba, visible evidence of an extremely powerful solar storm. When the disruption finally "made landfall" during the early morning of March 13, 1989, more than 200 American power grid problems emerged and the entire grid in Quebec Canada failed. The event, known as the Quebec Blackout, was by no means the most powerful solar storm to hit Earth. That distinction continues to be held (as of August 28, 2023) by the Carrington Event of 1859. On September 1st of that year, amateur skywatcher . The coronal mass ejection that Carrington had seen was massive and rather than the days it took during the Quebec Blackout. . The massive geomagnetic storm led to auroral displays in the tropics and wreaked havoc on the then-prevailing communications technology, the telegraph. According to History.com, While the breakdown of communications and power systems can indeed be concerning, . . It appeared to many military leaders as Soviet radar jamming these radar immediately prior to a nuclear attack on the United States. , but because of the Air Force's emerging interest in solar storms and space weather, solar forecasters at NORAD were able to convince military commanders that the radar attacks came from the sun. Yes, it's true, space weathermen prevented nuclear war! Unfortunately, the devastating impacts of powerful solar storms have been replicated by humans here on Earth. "" can be used to create similar, or even more powerful, effects. By intentionally creating and directing the power of a geomagnetic storm, these electromagnetic pulse . The effects could cripple the United States (or any other country for that matter), something made crystal clear by William Forstchen's novel (a book I highly recommend!). In fact, James Woolsey, former director of the US Central Intelligence Agency, testified in 2015 to the US Senate Committee on Homeland Security and Government Affairs on the potential impact of an EMP attack on America: In 2017, in the midst of tension-escalating regular rocket launches, North Korea state media noted that it possessed a "." | | ---|---|--- Source: Given our ever increasing reliance on technology and electricity, a Carrington Event or EMP attack on the United States would likely create chaos as power disappeared for weeks, months, or possibly even years. Forstchen's book provides a powerful scenario of what might transpire "one second after" an EMP attack. I won't ruin it or you, but imagine a world in which refrigeration wasn't available, cars didn't run, and basic societal safety nets broke down...for months and months. There is also a forthcoming documentary called "" produced by my friend David Tice and narrated by Dennis Quaid that does a superb job of highlighting our dependence on the grid and its many vulnerabilities. I recently watched it and can say without question that it should be required for all government officials, policymakers, business leaders, and students to watch. Preventing asymmetric threats from solar storms and EMP attacks is almost impossible to do. For one, we don't fully understand the dynamics within the sun and are still not able to predict when solar eruptions are going to happen, how large they may be, and in which direction they will point. Artificial intelligence and quantum computing promise to increase our understanding, but advancements are far from certain and the timing unknown. It's also notoriously hard to predict when a country like North Korea is going to launch a missile and its likely objective. Intelligence efforts can assist, but they rarely provide certainty. But in both cases, early warning systems can help us have a jump on preparing before the likely strikes. Space weather monitoring will continuously improve over time, and missile defense systems offer some promise in protecting critical infrastructure from EMP attacks. While we should definitely try to prevent or least learn rapidly about inbound solar storms or EMP attacks, it's also critical that we also focus on resilience and the ability to withstand magnetic disruptions. We've hardened much of our critical infrastructure against electricity surges from lightning strikes, why not do so from geomagnetic and electromagnetic pulses? In the grand scheme of matters, the additional cost is an insurance premium worth paying. Finally, we should develop plans for how we can coordinate monitoring, warning, resilience, and response efforts across the United States government. In this regard, the United States' and the are steps in the right direction. But we need to do a lot more. We must raise awareness of the risks and the many solutions that are available today. As "" makes clear, what's ultimately at risk is our way of life, and surely that's something everyone believes we should protect. I am lucky. I grew up in Ohio in the '90s back when America still valued merit.

If I'd been born 20 years later, my story would have been impossible. Today our nation is hungry for a cause; we want purpose and meaning.

The woke Left preys on that vacuum with a poisonous obsession with race, sexuality, and climate change. If you disagree with them, they call you a bigot. This is psychological slavery.

Fellow American, the best measure of the health of American democracy is the percentage of citizens who feel free to say what they actually think - _**IN PUBLIC.**_

Right now, we're failing that test.

**That's why I am running for President of the United States.**

We're starting a cultural movement in our country, Fellow American, and I want you to be a part of it. I want you to join our movement to create a new American dream for the next generation.

This time it isn't just about money. It is about the unapologetic pursuit of excellence itself. It means that we:

Believe in merit.
Believe in accountability.
Believe in free speech.

When I ran for the Senate, I knew what it would mean to become the first
openly gay Senator in our nation's history.

I understood that this would be an extraordinary opportunity to make a
difference in people's lives — and that’s what I’ve been hard at work
doing every day since. But, despite all of the hardfought progress my
Democratic colleagues and I have made, attacks on LGBTQ+ rights are
rampant across the country.

Extremist Republicans are working overtime to institute a wave of
anti-LGBTQ+ legislation. The 2023 legislative session has already seen
more than 650 bills designed to roll back LGBTQ+ rights, particularly
targeting transgender youth.

Amidst these unrelenting attacks, I refuse to be discouraged.

I first ran for public office to make a difference in people’s lives, and
I won’t let anti-LGBTQ+ Republicans turn back the clock. If you’re with
me, I hope I can count on you to add a small donation toward our fight

# Three Things to Know This Week:
---
1. Matt Dolan barnstorms in SE Ohio, highlights strong policy focus and expanded support
from Ohio law enforcement.

2. Matt Dolan earns national and state headlines after naming Jimmy and Dee Haslam as Ohio
Finance Chairs.

3. Matt Dolan continues to emphasize the importance of victory in November, retiring Sherrod Brown in 2024.

---
# Get up to speed...
---
|
---
**Matt Dolan barnstorms in SE Ohio, highlights strong policy focus and expanded support from**
**Ohio Law Enforcement.**
* On Friday, Matt Dolan attended the Southeast Ohio regional meeting of the Buckeye Sheriffs’ Association.

* During the meeting, which took place on a boat cruise hosted by Washington County Sheriff Larry Mincks, the group discussed issues vital to building a safer Ohio, particularly the crisis at the southern border.

* Sheriff Mincks is one of 19 sheriffs throughout Ohio who have endorsed Dolan’s campaign for US Senate. “Throughout his years in public service, Matt Dolan has always remained steadfast in his support for law enforcement,” Mincks said.

**_This was all happening while Shokin was aggressively investigating corruption by Burisma Holdings, who paid Hunter Biden over $1,000,000._**
This is huge. It completely undercuts the Democrats narrative going all the way back to 2019 when they used it as the pretense to impeach President Trump.

An October 2015 memo summarizing the recommendation of the Interagency Policy Committee (a task force created to advise the Obama White House on whether Ukraine was cleaning up its endemic corruption and deserved more Western foreign aid) **shows that U.S. policy did not call for a threat to withhold funding****!** Biden made the threat in December 2015, two months after the memo was published, and no other documents show the U.S. policy called for Shokin to be fired. On top of that, State Department officials sent Viktor Shokin a personal note saying they were “impressed” with his office’s work to clean up corruption and even invited his staff to Washington in January of 2016 for a “strategy session”. **And don’t forget, sworn testimony from Devon Archer holds that Burisma was putting constant pressure on Hunter Biden to “get help from Washington” regarding Viktor Shokin.** Democrats can’t hide from this much longer, the truth is coming out, whether they like it or not.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

| Peter, can I share something important with you?

Over the last six months we've held more than 100 campaign events across the country, met with thousands of voters, and drawn a line in the sand on important policy issues.

Now, I just completed my **FIRST** debate, and we're continuing to build a **SURGE** of momentum.

**BUT** , we still have a lot of ground to cover in order to win the White House and save our country!

_**[As we continue to build a winning campaign, I want to remind you why I am running for president and why your support matters.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=20005f9a1b524e5d81e170746c95d7c7&_e=XLVS5s0J6QDaoJZNzb5ROhIw8iVaGrPXOn5ed4xgvs6W68t1h7vFkikoDy3MUw-MlLGIl1MHewJ3aau6lfmNJXVpwKDD8NZ6PyARnOvOl957RKZBtAwzz8w2M3p-jaOkQBeiOGJNKJs_9XAgpS5W-g56BL94LKvz6rvRJVkL3KNBsnu4BWlKZx7ZWKTvf-kkYNDdXv3oxHHBsOR1u8WIy5kCwJBfe5KSFjg1FScpJk66ZNgLQWVC7KysjEdwRCE5BBSIadbiYn4pM_SkH65LuUf1RxPwUmYgKlqHurGnEiEmgUwXIL8f2FUdpg7Rr1Hvc3mpzNJYWwy-PJZNcmYI0iAV6q0rM32wkIrMSrb52lE%3D "As we continue to build a winning campaign, I want to remind you why I am running for president and why your support matters.")**_

I'm a proud daughter of legal immigrants, a wife of a combat veteran, and a mother of two. I have watched the American Dream unfold before me.

_**But, with the Democrats in power, our future is slipping. **_

Right now, we have too many families paying too much for groceries; too many small businesses who can't afford rent, and too many big businesses getting taxpayer bailouts.

We have too much crime on our streets - too many drugs flooding our cities - and too few police and border patrol.

And from Joe Biden on down, our leaders put too much trust in big government and too little trust in the American people.

They have us spiraling toward socialism, with a new trillion-dollar spending bill every few months, and _a national debt over 32 trillion dollars._

_**This is not the America I want to leave to my children! **_

I am running for president to save our country from the downward spiral of socialism and defeatism. I aim to move America upward toward freedom and strength.

_**[But, I need your help to make it happen. Can I count on you?](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=20005f9a1b524e5d81e170746c95d7c7&_e=XLVS5s0J6QDaoJZNzb5ROhIw8iVaGrPXOn5ed4xgvs6W68t1h7vFkikoDy3MUw-MlLGIl1MHewJ3aau6lfmNJXVpwKDD8NZ6PyARnOvOl957RKZBtAwzz8w2M3p-jaOkQBeiOGJNKJs_9XAgpS5W-g56BL94LKvz6rvRJVkL3KNBsnu4BWlKZx7ZWKTvf-kkaKp6AGx_TgGzpH2EUZcBEm7fVNSwQVQfoeD5sWhm2qxS74J9YP9hJLxwsuKBcupmoRyTAm4DTYZtV_9ZWNVaWDzuVezBb8x1h_3jnPA1zVKcwMvuf7cTJD2c1E8rjJ--UVMhxLZ8dEw3I_2ABcQCP-5WICwWRJKsqmY1MiGFLjU%3D "But, I need your help to make it happen. Can I count on you? ")**_

I can promise you, America is always worth fighting for.

As a brown girl, growing up in a black-and-white world, I saw the promise of America unfold before me.

As the proud wife of a combat veteran, I saw our people's deep love of freedom, and determination to defend it.

As Governor, I saw our state move beyond hate and violence, and lift everyone in peace.

And as Ambassador, I saw that America is still the standard.

Our moment is now - and our mission is clear.

_**[Will you help me save our country and secure our future?](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=20005f9a1b524e5d81e170746c95d7c7&_e=XLVS5s0J6QDaoJZNzb5ROhIw8iVaGrPXOn5ed4xgvs6W68t1h7vFkikoDy3MUw-MlLGIl1MHewJ3aau6lfmNJXVpwKDD8NZ6PyARnOvOl957RKZBtAwzz8w2M3p-jaOkQBeiOGJNKJs_9XAgpS5W-g56BL94LKvz6rvRJVkL3KNBsnu4BWlKZx7ZWKTvf-kkhelpnbICeU0waaUAPjt3l8b6lQD_kvWAomqI9WU7sCduoJJAEDeq3PQ6-OQokgKYxvaAhyfD08mIgdo8wbJsUD_j85W5f0Au0VDmwnARxrd_lAtr5FNl8Eb1BDMeX6p1vRRW9uU5auyBpDFVqIDletpEotl5E8TtgQ4VGx4zNT4%3D "Will you help me save our country and secure our future?")**_

Now, I just completed my FIRST debate, and we're continuing to build a SURGE of momentum. BUT , we still have a lot of ground to cover in order to win the White House and save our country! "As we continue to build a winning campaign, I want to remind you why I am running for president and why your support matters." | I'm a proud daughter of legal immigrants, a wife of a combat veteran, and a mother of two. I have watched the American Dream unfold before me. But, with the Democrats in power, our future is slipping. Right now, we have too many families paying too much for groceries; too many small businesses who can't afford rent, and too many big businesses getting taxpayer bailouts. We have too much crime on our streets - too many drugs flooding our cities - and too few police and border patrol. And from Joe Biden on down, our leaders put too much trust in big government and too little trust in the American people. They have us spiraling toward socialism, with a new trillion-dollar spending bill every few months, and a national debt over 32 trillion dollars. This is not the America I want to leave to my children! I am running for president to save our country from the downward spiral of socialism and defeatism. I aim to move America upward toward freedom and strength. "But, I need your help to make it happen. Can I count on you? " I can promise you, America is always worth fighting for. As a brown girl, growing up in a black-and-white world, I saw the promise of America unfold before me. As the proud wife of a combat veteran, I saw our people's deep love of freedom, and determination to defend it. As Governor, I saw our state move beyond hate and violence, and lift everyone in peace. And as Ambassador, I saw that America is still the standard. Our moment is now - and our mission is clear. "Will you help me save our country and secure our future?" | | "I appreciate your support more than you can imagine. If you can join me today by chipping in, it would mean so much to me." Thank you for everything you do for our country. My very best, Nikki R. body:
Voters deserved better than Wednesday’s debate.
| | |
---
| | | [ ](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=f5b7ab511b&e=0be619cbaa)
---
|
# BANNED.
---
|
---
| | |
---
| Friends, The corrupt RNC Establishment shut us out of the first GOP presidential debate. They wouldn’t even let my campaign team [enter the venue!](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=b52f1d6254&e=0be619cbaa) They ignored the call of patriots like [Kari Lake](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=1593f22896&e=0be619cbaa) who sounded the alarm about the damage the RNC could do by refusing to include me in the debate. They know the truth. I met all the qualifications necessary to earn a spot in Wednesday’s nationally-televised debate. As I told Newsmax, I was [shafted](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=2e540b9c7b&e=0be619cbaa), but it was the American people who lost out. They deserved to hear from the only candidate in the race who isn’t a billionaire or a career politician. So, it’s no surprise that Wednesday’s rigged debate descended into a [demolition derby](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=5a0b966b29&e=0be619cbaa), with candidates spending the entire evening tearing each other apart and no one offering a vision to defeat the Harris-Biden regime and restore America. Conservatives should expect more from the GOP leadership and the candidates who want our party’s nomination. [**That’s why I filed an FEC complaint against the RNC- to ensure that they honor their word and include ALL QUALIFIED CANDIDATES, including me, in the next presidential debate. Your donation today helps to fund our legal challenge of a corrupt establishment more interested in rewarding political friends than the will of Republican voters.**](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=b4bd4de034&e=0be619cbaa) In the meantime, I’m not going to let them stop me from talking about the issues that matter to the real Americans like you who make this country work. That includes breaking down our political silos and speaking to new audiences about how common sense solutions can help all Americans, no matter where they’re from or what they look like. That’s why, this week, I walked into the lion’s den. I appeared on [The Breakfast Club](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=436524bc07&e=0be619cbaa), one of the most popular black radio shows in America. There, I spoke the hard truth about the epidemic of fatherlessness in America and how it’s fueling our crime and education crisis. I pushed back on the race narrative that’s used to divide Americans on trivial grounds like skin color. Winning in 2024 will involve taking the case for conservatism to every corner of this country and striving to reunify a country torn apart by years of needless political divisions. Banning popular candidates from even entering the debate venue, as the RNC did this week, shows they just don’t understand what needs to be done. [**Bottom line: I’ll never run away from a fight, and I won’t let the political establishment ignore the will of We the People. But I can’t do it alone, which is why now, more than ever, my campaign is counting on our grassroots army of supporters like YOU to help fund this critical legal challenge to the Washington elite.

With your support, we’ll make it to the next debate, and we’ll share with the entire country our vision for a new Golden Age for America. Please, give whatever you can today.**](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=f10a1d0a48&e=0be619cbaa) Standing with you,
Larry Elder
GOP Candidate for President

clean_body: | | | | Peter, my story starts with my grandmother Natividad or as we like to call her “Nettie”. Her family immigrated here from Mexico so that their children could live a better life and achieve the American dream. I’m grateful for the opportunity my grandmother provided for me. I’m proud of my Latina roots. Without her, I wouldn’t have had the opportunity to be one of the first Latinas elected to Congress from the state of Oregon. The policies I’m fighting for now are because of my family - like you, I want what’s best for my family, our state, and our nation. As a mom, I understand the importance of parental choice. The Parental Bill of Rights ensures transparent school curriculums and safeguards parents' rights to influence their children's education. I married my high school sweetheart, Dr. Shawn DeRemer. I was fortunate enough to support us as he finished medical school. We then founded an anesthesia management company and opened several other medical clinics in the Pacific Northwest. As a small business owner, I understand the important role small businesses play in our economy. Small business owners have enough on their plate - that’s why I support legislation that makes it easier for small businesses to stay open across the country. I'm telling you all of this, because it's a big part of why I’m running for Congress again in 2024 – to fight for families like yours and mine. But I need your help. Last cycle OR-05 was a battleground district - we won by just 7,299 votes \- we can’t take that risk again this cycle. It's going to take a historic outpouring of grassroots support to beat our opponent, and I don't want to risk losing because we didn't have the resources we needed. | | Thank you, Lori Chavez-DeRemer Congresswoman OR-05 | | | | | | | | | Even as a Congresswoman, Lori’s most important title is mom. That’s how she knows the issues your family faces, and that’s why she fights everyday to make life better for every Oregon family, and every American. Aside from that, all you need to know are the issues she’s fighting for in Congress: If that sounds like the kind of agenda you can get behind, If you’d prefer to give by check, please use the below address: Lori Chavez-DeRemer for Congress 13203 SE 172nd Ave Suite 166 #399 Happy Valley, OR 97086 Forward This message to FIVE FRIENDS AND FAMILY to spread the word on how to achieve a better future for Oregon and America → ** Also text “LORI” to 71800 or click here to receive all of Lori’s messages | | | | Lori Chavez-DeRemer 13203 SE 172nd Ave, Suite 166 #399, Happy Valley, OR 97086 == \-

body:
Pramila’s work has not slowed down during the summer, and our crises and issues are still very real.
#
Oh how time flies, Peter.
August is already wrapping up, and our team has been checking our fundraising numbers to ensure that we’re on the right track to reach our goal.
But this month, we’ve seen a slow down in our fundraising and we really want to make sure we can keep pace with our campaign’s goals. **That’s why we’re rounding out August by kicking off our end-of-month fundraising to help us reach our $12,000 goal before Wednesday night.**
**[If you stand with us, please rush a contribution to our campaign to fix our Supreme Court and re-instill trust, honor, and integrity in our legislative systems.](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/44830?refcode=em20230828-2861&t=1&akid=2861%2E420207%2EqYdnQ3)**
**[Donate ››](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/44830?refcode=em20230828-2861&t=20&akid=2861%2E420207%2EqYdnQ3)**
A summer slow-down in fundraising is quite common for campaigns like ours. As people are out enjoying the summer weather, spending time with family and friends, and more — they’re not looking to their inboxes for emails like this one.
**That’s why we have to rely on our most dedicated supporters to help us maintain our momentum and continue pushing us towards success.**
**Pramila’s work has not slowed down during the summer, and our crises and issues are still very real. That means, we need to make sure our funds can continue supporting Pramila while she fights for us in Congress, and strengthen our momentum, even through a summer slump.**
**[If you stand with us, please chip in $3, $5, $10, or more today to help us kick off our goal. We need as much support as possible to help us cover lost ground and keep up with our campaign’s future plans through the end of August and beyond.](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/44830?refcode=em20230828-2861&t=21&akid=2861%2E420207%2EqYdnQ3)**
Together,
Team Jayapal

body:
Hey there, it’s Alex Padilla. My friend Jacky Rosen is in a tough re-election fight in Nevada, and we’re working to support her. I hope you’ll read the message from her below, and then [**consider splitting a contribution between our campaigns.](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-august23-rosen.nPhahr&refcode=em230828-1-30&t=1&akid=1503%2E159979%2E1q0w2Z)**

Can I tell you the story of how I first got involved in politics?
While serving as the president of Nevada's largest synagogue, I was recruited to run in a competitive House race to help flip a red seat blue. Looking back, it's incredibly fitting that _this_ was my entry point to public service – **because my Judaism is at the very _core_ of my work in the Senate today.**
**In fact, my decision to say "yes" and run for public office in the first place was guided by the Jewish principle of Tikkun Olam – which means to leave the world a better place than how we found it.**
Now, as the third Jewish woman and only former synagogue president in Senate history, I'm proud to serve Nevada and our country. And as we face everything from growing antisemitism to attacks on reproductive freedom to threats to tear down our very democracy, I'm as committed as ever to keep fighting to better this world and make positive change happen. **But I need your help.**
**Mitch McConnell's handpicked candidate has launched his campaign to defeat me, and recent polling shows me _2 points down_ in the race that experts say will likely decide Senate control. So please, I'm humbly asking:**
[**If the principle of Tikkun Olam resonates with you – if you're with me in the fight to continue making progress for the people and communities that we love – will you chip in $3 or more today - to split between my campaign and Alex Padilla’s - to help defend my seat in Nevada and our Democratic Senate majority?](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-august23-rosen.nPhahr&refcode=em230828-1-30&t=3&akid=1503%2E159979%2E1q0w2Z)**

name: Sepi Shyne
subject: What this campaign means to me
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY SEPI SHYNE FOR CONGRESS
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_shyne?refcode=wrpr_hdr [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_shyne?refcode=wrpr_hdr]
Friend,

When people ask me why I'm running for Congress, I like to share my story.

Before my family and I fled Iran, we lived in fear of the violence of the Revolutionary Guard. For a time, my father was jailed for speaking out against the regime.

Women's rights were practically non-existent; we were not even allowed to be in the streets with men or boys who were not our family. I had to cut my hair short and pretend to be a boy so I could play soccer with my friends from the neighborhood. As a queer woman, had I stayed in Iran I might not be alive today.

I've felt the effects of authoritarianism and fundamentalism firsthand, friend, and the extremism happening in our country disturbs me.

Here in our own country, civil rights are under siege. Red states across the country have passed bills targeting trans youth, gutting reproductive rights, and twisting the history and science curricula that are taught in schools.

We're seeing new levels of violence and hatred against Black, Indigenous and other people of color, LGBTQ+ Americans, and immigrants — a rising tide that echoes the worst of the discrimination and prejudice I faced when I first immigrated to the United States.

I've dedicated over two decades of my life to defending our civil rights. To fight back against the rise in hate born from extremism, I feel called to fight for us in Congress.

We deserve a future where every single person can thrive, free from discrimination, violence, and crushing inequality. I'm running for Congress to build that future. I hope you'll join me. **My name is Debbie Mucarsel-Powell. I’m an immigrant, mother, and former Congresswoman. Today, I’m announcing my campaign to defeat Sen. Rick Scott and serve as Florida’s next U.S. Senator.**

Rick Scott has failed us in Florida, and I refuse to sit back and watch him push my state and country backward. I’m prepared to fight to protect our rights, our economy, and our very democracy — and even more, I’m prepared to win.

But this race will be one of the most competitive Senate races in 2024, and we’re up against a deep-seated Republican incumbent who spent $64 million of his personal fortune to buy this seat last time around. The only way I can compete — and _win_ — is with the support of grassroots Democrats like you.

| | Dear Peter,
---
| **I’m excited to share that Medina County Precinct Chair Connie Buske has endorsed my campaign to serve Texas’ 23rd District in Congress!**
---
| [ ](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fcc3d4d56d2b95c7d6dfed110&id=4fd7476871&e=c982eb7ad4)
